# Design Document: AIESEC Tunisia â€” Bardo Multi-Page Platform

## Overview

A production-grade, multi-page website for AIESEC Tunisia / Bardo. Five pages serve distinct user purposes: an immersive home entry point, a Discover Bardo explainer, a filterable project listing, a practical Tunisian lifestyle guide, and a searchable FAQ. A floating chat agent powered by a unified knowledge base persists across all pages.

Built with Next.js 14+ App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. All content is driven by a typed data layer under `/data`. The 3D globe on the home page uses `react-globe.gl` loaded as a client-only dynamic import.

### Content Quality Note

> **Discover Bardo** and **Tunisian Lifestyle** pages MUST prioritize practical, accurate value for a first-time visitor to Tunisia. Content in these pages â€” reasons to choose Tunisia, journey steps, lifestyle guidance, transport options, language phrases, etiquette tips, safety advice, and packing lists â€” must be grounded in real, useful information. Placeholder or filler content is not acceptable for these two pages. All data in `discover-bardo.ts` and `lifestyle.ts` must reflect genuine guidance a first-time exchange participant would need.

---

```
â””â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”˜
```

### Rendering Strategy

- Pages and static sections: React Server Components by default
- Interactive components (Hero, Stats, Globe, Estimator, Filters, FAQ accordion, ChatAgent): Client Components with `"use client"`
- Data layer: pure TypeScript modules, imported at build time, zero runtime fetching
- Globe: `next/dynamic` with `ssr: false` â€” never server-rendered

## Component Design

### Navbar (`components/layout/Navbar.tsx`)

Updated from anchor hashes to `next/link` page routes:

```typescript
const navLinks = [
  { href: "/",                   label: "Home" },
  { href: "/discover-bardo",     label: "Discover" },
  { href: "/our-projects",       label: "Projects" },
  { href: "/tunisian-lifestyle", label: "Lifestyle" },
  { href: "/faq",                label: "FAQ" },
];
```

Active state: `const pathname = usePathname()` â†’ `pathname === link.href` â†’ `text-white border-b-2 border-accent`.

### GlobeSection / GlobeCanvas (`components/globe/`)

**GlobeSection** â€” Server Component wrapper:
- Section layout, heading, description text
- Renders `<GlobeCanvas>` via `next/dynamic` with `ssr: false`
- Uses `useInView` to pass `isVisible` prop â€” GlobeCanvas only mounts when visible

**GlobeCanvas** â€” Client Component:
```typescript
"use client";
import Globe from "react-globe.gl";

interface GlobeCanvasProps {
  arcs: GlobeArc[];
  reducedMotion: boolean;
}
```

Config:
- `globeImageUrl`: dark Earth texture or `/images/globe-dark.png`
- `arcsData`: `globeArcs` from data layer
- `arcColor`: direction-based â€” outbound = accent, inbound = `rgba(255,255,255,0.6)`
- `arcDashAnimateTime`: `2000` (disabled when `reducedMotion`)
- `autoRotate`: `true` (disabled when `reducedMotion`)
- `autoRotateSpeed`: `0.3`
- `backgroundColor`: `rgba(0,0,0,0)`
- Tunisia highlight: `polygonsData` with Tunisia GeoJSON polygon, filled with accent color

Performance protections:
- `next/dynamic` with `ssr: false` and `loading` fallback (dark circle `<div>`)
- `useInView` threshold `0.2` â€” canvas only mounts when section is 20% visible
- `useReducedMotion()` from Framer Motion â€” disables animation and rotation
- Mobile: arc count capped at 8, `autoRotate: false`
- Canvas width/height bound to container via `ResizeObserver`

### ProjectFilters (`components/projects/ProjectFilters.tsx`)

**Client Component** â€” filter state management.

```typescript
interface FilterState {
  category: ProjectCategory | "all";
  sdgs: SDG[];
  city: string | "all";
  status: "open" | "closed" | "all";
  startDate: string;
  endDate: string;
}
```

- Filter state lives in `ProjectFilters` and is lifted to the page via callback
- Active filter chips rendered below the filter bar
- "Clear all" resets to default state
- `filterProjects(projects, filters)` pure function in `lib/utils.ts`

### FAQ Accordion (`components/faq/FaqAccordion.tsx`)

**Client Component**:
- Each item: `<button>` trigger with `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls` pointing to the answer panel
- Answer panel: `overflow-hidden` container with `max-height` CSS transition (0 â†’ measured content height) and simultaneous `opacity` transition (0 â†’ 1)
- Chevron icon: `transform: rotate(0deg)` â†’ `rotate(180deg)` CSS transition
- No layout-affecting properties other than `max-height` are animated
- Keyboard: Enter/Space toggles the focused item, arrow keys move focus between items

### ChatAgent â€” Knowledge Base Integration

`ChatAgent` imports `knowledgeBase` from `data/knowledge-base.ts` instead of `faqEntries` from `data/faq.ts`. The `matchFaq` call signature is unchanged â€” it receives `KnowledgeEntry[]` which satisfies the same interface.

Phase 2 path (not implemented now): replace `knowledgeBase` import with a `useSWR("/api/knowledge")` call. Zero changes to `ChatPanel` or `matchFaq`.

## Animation Patterns

All existing animation patterns from the original design are preserved (parallax, counter, video autoplay, reduced motion). New additions:

### FAQ Accordion
```
button click â†’ toggle isOpen state
  â†“
answer panel: max-height: 0 â†’ max-height: {contentHeight}px  (CSS transition)
              opacity: 0 â†’ opacity: 1                         (CSS transition)
chevron:      rotate(0deg) â†’ rotate(180deg)                   (CSS transform transition)
```
No layout-affecting properties other than max-height are animated.

### Project Card Entrance
```
useInView({ threshold: 0.1 }) on ProjectGrid
  â†“
motion.div staggered: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 24 }} â†’ animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
  delay: index * 0.05
```

### Globe Arc (react-globe.gl built-in)
```
arcDashLength: 0.4
arcDashGap: 0.2
arcDashAnimateTime: 2000   (0 when reducedMotion)
```

## Performance and Accessibility

All original performance and accessibility patterns are preserved. Additions:

- `next/link` prefetching for all internal page navigation
- `react-globe.gl` loaded only via `next/dynamic` with `ssr: false`
- Globe canvas only mounts on viewport entry (IntersectionObserver via `useInView`)
- Project filtering is pure client-side â€” no network requests
- FAQ search is pure client-side string matching
- All new interactive components (accordion, filters, tabs) are keyboard accessible
- `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `role="tablist"`, `role="tab"` used correctly on FAQ and filter components

# Requirements Document

## Introduction

A production-grade, multi-page website for the AIESEC Tunisia / Bardo experience platform. The platform is designed to be genuinely useful for someone discovering Tunisia for the first time â€” covering cultural exchange opportunities, Tunisian lifestyle guidance, filterable project listings, and a comprehensive FAQ. Built with Next.js 14+ App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.

The site consists of five pages: Home (`/`), Discover Bardo (`/discover-bardo`), Our Projects (`/our-projects`), Tunisian Lifestyle (`/tunisian-lifestyle`), and FAQ (`/faq`). A floating chat agent persists across all pages and draws from a unified knowledge base.

## Glossary

- **Platform**: The full multi-page Next.js website served at the root of the workspace
- **Home_Page**: The root route `/` â€” immersive entry point with hero, stats, globe, page teasers, and CTA
- **Discover_Page**: The `/discover-bardo` route â€” explains Bardo, AIESEC Tunisia, and the exchange journey
- **Projects_Page**: The `/our-projects` route â€” filterable listing of exchange opportunities
- **Lifestyle_Page**: The `/tunisian-lifestyle` route â€” practical discovery guide for first-time visitors
- **FAQ_Page**: The `/faq` route â€” searchable, categorized knowledge base with expandable answers
- **Hero_Section**: The full-viewport immersive media wall at the top of the Home_Page
- **Media_Card**: A rounded card displaying either an image or a looping video preview
- **Stats_Section**: The animated counter section displaying key program metrics
- **Globe_Section**: The 3D interactive globe on the Home_Page showing Tunisia's global connections
- **GlobeCanvas**: The client-only WebGL canvas component rendering the react-globe.gl instance
- **Globe_Arc**: A typed data record describing an animated connection arc on the globe
- **CTA_Section**: The full-width call-to-action section
- **Chat_Agent**: The floating chat panel anchored to the bottom-right of the viewport, present on all pages
- **Knowledge_Base**: The unified set of typed entries aggregated from all data domains for the Chat_Agent
- **Data_Layer**: All TypeScript files under `/data` supplying typed content to components
- **Project**: A typed exchange opportunity record with slug, SDGs, dates, city, category, and status
- **SDG**: UN Sustainable Development Goal, numbered 1â€“17
- **FAQ_Entry**: A typed question/answer record with keywords, topic category, and answer text
- **Accent_Color**: The primary brand highlight color (AIESEC blue/teal)
- **Viewport**: The visible area of the browser window

---

## Requirements

### Requirement 1: Project Structure and Multi-Page Configuration

**User Story:** As a developer, I want a clean Next.js 14+ App Router multi-page project at the workspace root, so that all five routes are accessible and the application runs immediately with `npm run dev`.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE Platform SHALL be structured with the following app routes at the workspace root: `/`, `/discover-bardo`, `/our-projects`, `/tunisian-lifestyle`, and `/faq`.
2. THE Platform SHALL include root configuration files: `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `next.config.mjs`, `postcss.config.js`, `tailwind.config.ts`, `app/globals.css`, and `README.md`.
3. WHEN a developer runs `npm run dev`, THE Platform SHALL start without errors and all five routes SHALL be reachable.
4. THE Platform SHALL use TypeScript for all source files under `/app`, `/components`, `/data`, and `/lib`.
5. THE Data_Layer SHALL export typed interfaces and content arrays from dedicated files under `/data`.
6. THE Platform SHALL use `next/link` for all internal navigation between pages.
7. THE Navbar SHALL use `usePathname()` to apply an active visual state to the link matching the current route.
8. THE Chat_Agent SHALL be rendered in `app/layout.tsx` so it persists across all five pages without remounting.

---

### Requirement 2: Hero Immersive Media Wall (Home)

**User Story:** As a visitor, I want to see a cinematic full-viewport media wall on the home page, so that I am immediately immersed in the AIESEC Tunisia experience.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE Hero_Section SHALL render three horizontal rows of Media_Cards on desktop viewports (â‰¥ 1024px).
2. WHEN the page loads on desktop, THE Hero_Section SHALL display each Media_Card in a grayscale, slightly darkened cinematic state by default.
3. WHEN a visitor hovers over a Media_Card on desktop, THE Hero_Section SHALL scale the card up, remove the grayscale filter, and bring the card visually forward using CSS transform and z-index.
4. WHEN a visitor hovers over a Media_Card containing a video on desktop, THE Hero_Section SHALL begin playing the video preview.
5. WHEN the visitor moves the cursor away from a Media_Card on desktop, THE Hero_Section SHALL revert the card to its default cinematic state and pause any playing video.
6. WHILE the page is scrolled on desktop, THE Hero_Section SHALL apply a parallax effect where adjacent rows scroll in opposite horizontal directions using transform-based animation only.
7. THE Hero_Section SHALL render a centered overlay with an abstract human silhouette and the text "Behind each exchange a STORY", where "STORY" is rendered in the Accent_Color.
8. THE Hero_Section SHALL render one or two vertical columns of Media_Cards on mobile viewports (< 1024px) with no hover interactions.
9. WHEN a Media_Card containing a video enters the Viewport on mobile, THE Hero_Section SHALL begin playing the video.
10. WHEN a Media_Card containing a video exits the Viewport on mobile, THE Hero_Section SHALL pause the video.
11. THE Hero_Section SHALL load all content from `/data/hero-media.ts`, supporting both image and video types with a `poster` field for videos.
12. THE Hero_Section SHALL set `preload="metadata"` on all video elements.
13. THE Hero_Section SHALL use only CSS `transform` and `opacity` for all animations.

---

### Requirement 3: Stats Counter Section (Home)

**User Story:** As a visitor, I want to see animated statistics about the AIESEC program, so that I understand the scale and impact of the exchange network.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE Stats_Section SHALL display labeled numeric counters loaded from `/data/stats.ts`.
2. WHEN the Stats_Section enters the Viewport, THE Stats_Section SHALL animate each counter from 0 to its target value.
3. THE Stats_Section SHALL display suffix labels (e.g., "+", "k+") as defined in the data.
4. WHEN the animation has already played and the section re-enters the Viewport, THE Stats_Section SHALL NOT restart the animation.
5. THE Stats_Section SHALL complete each counter animation within 2000ms of entering the Viewport.

---

### Requirement 4: 3D Globe Section (Home)

**User Story:** As a visitor, I want to see a 3D globe showing Tunisia's global connections, so that I understand the international reach of the exchange program.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE Globe_Section SHALL render a 3D interactive globe using `react-globe.gl`, loaded as a client-only dynamic import with `ssr: false`.
2. THE Globe_Section SHALL display Tunisia highlighted in the Accent_Color on the globe surface.
3. THE Globe_Section SHALL render animated arcs from Tunisia to destination countries (outbound) and from source countries to Tunisia (inbound), sourced from `/data/globe-routes.ts`. The initial implementation SHALL include 8â€“12 arcs for performance focus.
4. WHEN the Globe_Section enters the Viewport, THE GlobeCanvas SHALL initialize and begin rendering â€” it SHALL NOT initialize before the section is visible.
5. WHILE the GlobeCanvas is loading, THE Globe_Section SHALL display a static dark circular placeholder.
6. THE Globe_Section SHALL use a dark visual style consistent with the overall site theme.
7. THE Globe_Section SHALL auto-rotate slowly and stop rotation when the user interacts with the globe.
8. WHERE a visitor has enabled `prefers-reduced-motion`, THE Globe_Section SHALL disable arc animation and auto-rotation, displaying a static globe.
9. ON mobile viewports, THE Globe_Section SHALL reduce arc count and disable auto-rotation to maintain performance.
10. THE Globe_Section SHALL be responsive, fitting within its container on all viewport sizes.
11. Globe arc data SHALL be typed via the `GlobeArc` interface in `/data/globe-routes.ts`.

---

### Requirement 5: Page Teasers and CTA (Home)

**User Story:** As a visitor who has scrolled the home page, I want clear signposts to the other pages, so that I know where to go next.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE Home_Page SHALL render a set of teaser cards linking to `/discover-bardo`, `/our-projects`, and `/tunisian-lifestyle` using `next/link`.
2. Each teaser card SHALL display a title, short description, and a visual cue.
3. THE CTA_Section SHALL span the full width of the viewport and display "Live your experience with Bardo" with a primary action button in the Accent_Color.

---

### Requirement 6: Discover Bardo Page

**User Story:** As a first-time visitor, I want a page that explains what Bardo and AIESEC Tunisia are, so that I can decide whether this experience is right for me.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE Discover_Page SHALL include a page hero with a tagline and background image.
2. THE Discover_Page SHALL include a "What is Bardo" section explaining the platform's purpose.
3. THE Discover_Page SHALL include a "What AIESEC does here" section covering AIESEC Tunisia's role and history.
4. THE Discover_Page SHALL include a "Why Tunisia" section with at least four distinct reasons, loaded from `/data/discover-bardo.ts`.
5. THE Discover_Page SHALL include a "Who is this for" section with persona cards (e.g., student, young professional, volunteer), loaded from `/data/discover-bardo.ts`.
6. THE Discover_Page SHALL include a participant journey timeline showing the steps from application to completion, loaded from `/data/discover-bardo.ts`.
7. THE Discover_Page SHALL include a support section describing pre-arrival and during-exchange support.
8. THE Discover_Page SHALL include an experience highlights section with at least three highlight blocks or quote cards, loaded from `/data/discover-bardo.ts`.
9. THE Discover_Page SHALL end with a CTA linking to `/our-projects`.
10. All content on THE Discover_Page SHALL be sourced from the Data_Layer â€” no hardcoded strings inside components.

### Requirement 7: Our Projects Page

**User Story:** As a prospective exchange participant, I want to browse and filter available projects, so that I can find an opportunity that matches my interests and timeline.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE Projects_Page SHALL render a grid of Project cards loaded from `/data/projects.ts`.
2. Each Project card SHALL display: title, description, image, city, category, SDG badges, date range, and open/closed status.
3. THE Projects_Page SHALL provide a filter bar with controls for: category, SDG (multi-select), city, status (open/closed), and date range (start and end).
4. WHEN a visitor applies filters, THE Projects_Page SHALL update the displayed project list in real time without page reload.
5. THE Projects_Page SHALL display an active filter summary showing applied filters as removable chips.
6. THE Projects_Page SHALL provide a "Clear all filters" control that resets all filters simultaneously.
7. WHEN no projects match the active filters, THE Projects_Page SHALL display a friendly empty state with a reset CTA.
8. THE Projects_Page SHALL be future-ready for project detail pages: each Project SHALL have a `slug` field, and the route `/our-projects/[slug]` SHALL be reserved (returning a placeholder or 404 for now).
9. THE `Project` interface SHALL include: `id`, `slug`, `title`, `description`, `image`, `alt`, `sdgs` (SDG[]), `startDate`, `endDate`, `city`, `category`, `isOpen`.
10. Filter state SHALL be managed client-side with no server round-trips.

### Requirement 8: Tunisian Lifestyle Page

**User Story:** As a first-time visitor preparing for an exchange, I want a practical guide to life in Tunisia, so that I can arrive informed and confident.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE Lifestyle_Page SHALL include a food section reusing the existing `FoodSection` component and `/data/foods.ts`.
2. THE Lifestyle_Page SHALL include a places-to-visit section reusing the existing `PlacesSection` component and `/data/places.ts`.

4. THE Lifestyle_Page SHALL include a transport guide section with options (metro, bus, taxi, apps) loaded from `/data/lifestyle.ts`.
5. THE Lifestyle_Page SHALL include a climate and seasons section with month-by-month or season-based guidance loaded from `/data/lifestyle.ts`.
6. THE Lifestyle_Page SHALL include a language basics section with key phrases in Arabic and French loaded from `/data/lifestyle.ts`.
7. THE Lifestyle_Page SHALL include a local etiquette section with cultural do/don't guidance loaded from `/data/lifestyle.ts`.
8. THE Lifestyle_Page SHALL include a safety and daily life section with practical tips loaded from `/data/lifestyle.ts`.
9. THE Lifestyle_Page SHALL include a "what to pack" section with a checklist-style layout loaded from `/data/lifestyle.ts`.
10. All content on THE Lifestyle_Page SHALL be sourced from the Data_Layer â€” no hardcoded strings inside components.

### Requirement 9: FAQ Page

**User Story:** As a visitor with specific questions, I want a searchable, categorized FAQ page, so that I can quickly find answers and feel confident about the exchange.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE FAQ_Page SHALL render all entries from `/data/faq.ts` as expandable accordion items.
2. THE FAQ_Page SHALL provide a search input that filters visible entries in real time by matching against question text and keywords.
3. THE FAQ_Page SHALL provide category tabs (Cost, Tunisia, AIESEC, General) that filter entries by topic.
4. WHEN both a search query and a category are active, THE FAQ_Page SHALL apply both filters simultaneously.
5. WHEN no entries match the active search and category, THE FAQ_Page SHALL display a friendly empty state.
6. THE FAQ_Page SHALL display a handoff CTA at the bottom: "Still have questions? Contact AIESEC Tunisia" with email and Instagram links.
7. Each accordion item SHALL animate open and closed using a `max-height` CSS transition on the answer panel combined with an `opacity` transition, and a `transform: rotate` transition on the chevron icon. Layout-affecting properties other than `max-height` SHALL NOT be animated.
8. THE FAQ_Page SHALL be keyboard accessible: accordion items SHALL be operable via Enter/Space, and focus SHALL move logically through the list.

---

### Requirement 10: Floating Chat Agent (All Pages)

**User Story:** As a visitor on any page, I want a floating chat assistant I can open at any time, so that I can get quick answers without navigating away.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE Chat_Agent SHALL be anchored to the bottom-right corner of the Viewport and remain visible during scroll on all five pages.
2. THE Chat_Agent SHALL display an animated AIESEC-style SVG character with a continuous idle floating animation.
3. WHEN a visitor clicks the Chat_Agent trigger, THE Chat_Agent SHALL open a chat panel.
4. WHEN a visitor clicks the trigger while the panel is open, THE Chat_Agent SHALL close the panel.
5. THE Chat_Agent SHALL operate entirely on the frontend with no external API calls.
6. THE Chat_Agent SHALL match user input against the unified Knowledge_Base built from `/data/knowledge-base.ts`.
7. THE Knowledge_Base SHALL aggregate entries from: `faq.ts`, `lifestyle.ts`, `discover-bardo.ts`, and `projects.ts`.
8. Each Knowledge_Base entry SHALL conform to the `KnowledgeEntry` interface with fields: `id`, `keywords`, `question`, `answer`, `topic`, `source`.
9. WHEN no Knowledge_Base entry matches the visitor's input, THE Chat_Agent SHALL display a fallback message directing the visitor to contact AIESEC Tunisia.
10. THE Chat_Agent panel SHALL be keyboard accessible with focus trapped inside while open, and closeable via Escape key.
11. THE `matchFaq` utility in `lib/utils.ts` SHALL accept `KnowledgeEntry[]` so it works with the expanded knowledge base without interface changes.

---

### Requirement 11: Performance and Accessibility (All Pages)

**User Story:** As a developer and end user, I want the platform to load fast and be accessible, so that all visitors can use it regardless of device or ability.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE Platform SHALL use `next/image` for all static images.
2. THE Platform SHALL lazy-load all video elements using `preload="metadata"` and only autoplay when in the Viewport.
3. THE Platform SHALL use only CSS `transform` and `opacity` for all animations.
4. THE Platform SHALL include descriptive `alt` attributes on all images, sourced from the Data_Layer.
5. THE Platform SHALL use semantic HTML (`<header>`, `<main>`, `<section>`, `<nav>`, `<footer>`, `<button>`, `<h1>`â€“`<h3>`) throughout.
6. WHERE `prefers-reduced-motion` is enabled, THE Platform SHALL disable or reduce all non-essential animations, including globe rotation and arc animation.
7. THE Platform SHALL ensure all interactive elements are keyboard navigable.
8. THE Platform SHALL maintain a mobile-first responsive layout using Tailwind breakpoints at `sm:640px`, `md:768px`, `lg:1024px`, `xl:1280px`.
9. THE GlobeCanvas SHALL only be initialized when its section enters the Viewport, preventing unnecessary WebGL context creation on page load.

# Implementation Plan: Hero Visual Editor (Phase 1)

## Overview

Implement a config-driven hero layout editor for the AIESEC Tunisia Next.js site. The work proceeds in layers: types â†’ defaults â†’ storage â†’ API â†’ preview component â†’ public page refactor â†’ editor UI. Each task is independently deployable and builds on the previous.

    - Define `LayerProps`, `ParallaxConfig`, `LayerType`

    - Define `HeroLayoutConfig { id: "hero"; version: number; layers: AnyLayer[] }`
    - Export all types

  - [x] 1.2 Create `lib/hero-layout-defaults.ts` with `DEFAULT_HERO_CONFIG`

$projectsClientContent = @'
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import type { GroupedProject } from "@/lib/projects/grouped-types";
import { ProjectFilters } from "./ProjectFilters";
import { GroupedProjectGrid } from "./GroupedProjectGrid";
import { ProjectCategorySelector } from "./ProjectCategorySelector";
import { filterProjects, type FilterState } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { SDG } from "@/data/projects";

const DEFAULT_FILTERS: FilterState = {
  category: "all",
  sdgs: [],
  city: "all",
  status: "all",
  startDate: "",
  endDate: "",
};

interface ProjectsPageClientProps {
  projects: GroupedProject[];
  locale: string;
}

function normalizeCategory(value: string | null): Exclude<FilterState["category"], "all"> | null {
  if (value === "volunteer" || value === "talent" || value === "teaching") {
    return value;
  }
  return null;
}

export function ProjectsPageClient({ projects, locale }: ProjectsPageClientProps) {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const selectedCategory = normalizeCategory(searchParams.get("category"));
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<FilterState>(DEFAULT_FILTERS);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedCategory) {
      setFilters({
        ...DEFAULT_FILTERS,
        category: selectedCategory,
      });
    } else {
      setFilters(DEFAULT_FILTERS);
    }
  }, [selectedCategory]);

  const availableSdgs = useMemo(
    () =>
      Array.from(
        new Set<number>(projects.flatMap((project) => project.sdgs as number[]))
      ).sort((a, b) => a - b) as SDG[],
    [projects]
  );

  const filtered = useMemo(
    () => filterProjects(projects, filters),
    [projects, filters]
  );

  const resetHref = `/${locale}/our-projects`;

  if (!selectedCategory) {
    return <ProjectCategorySelector projects={projects} locale={locale} />;
  }

  return (
    <section aria-label="Projects listing" className="py-16 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-col gap-8">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="text-accent text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.22em] mb-3">
              Category selected
            </p>
            <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-gray-900 leading-tight capitalize">
              {selectedCategory} projects
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-3 text-gray-500 text-sm sm:text-base max-w-2xl leading-relaxed">
              The filter bar below stays active, so you can refine this category further.
            </p>
          </div>

          <a
            href={resetHref}
            className="inline-flex items-center justify-center px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full border border-gray-200 text-gray-700 text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors focus-ring"
          >
            Back to selection
          </a>
        </div>

        <ProjectFilters
          filters={filters}
          availableSdgs={availableSdgs}
          onChange={setFilters}
        />

        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-medium tabular-nums">
          {filtered.length} project{filtered.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} found
        </p>

        <GroupedProjectGrid
          projects={filtered}
          locale={locale}
          onReset={() => setFilters({ ...DEFAULT_FILTERS, category: selectedCategory })}
        />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

Write-Section "Writing aligned flat transformer"
$transformContent = @'
import type { Project } from "@/data/projects";
import type { GisOpportunity } from "./gis-types";

function slugify(value: string) {
  return value
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/&/g, "and")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/(^-|-$)+/g, "");
}

function mapCategory(opp: GisOpportunity): "volunteer" | "talent" | "teaching" {
  const id = opp.programme?.id;

  if (id === "7") return "volunteer"; // GV
  if (id === "8") return "talent";    // GTa
  if (id === "9") return "teaching";  // GTe

  return "volunteer";
}

function pickPrimarySlot(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  const slots = opp.all_slots?.nodes ?? [];
  return slots.find((slot) => slot.status === "live") ?? slots[0] ?? null;
}

function buildDescription(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  const base = (opp.description ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  const logistics = [];
  if (opp.logistics_info?.accommodation_covered === "covered") logistics.push("accommodation");
  if (opp.logistics_info?.food_covered === "covered") logistics.push("meals");
  if (opp.logistics_info?.transportation_covered === "covered") logistics.push("transportation");

  const extras = [];
  if (logistics.length > 0) extras.push(`Includes: ${logistics.join(", ")}.`);
  if (opp.fee_and_health_insurance?.total) {
    extras.push(`Programme fee: ${opp.fee_and_health_insurance.total} ${opp.fee_and_health_insurance.currency ?? ""}.`.trim());
  }

  return [base, ...extras].filter(Boolean).join(" ").trim();
}

export function transformGisOpportunity(opp: GisOpportunity): Project {
  const slot = pickPrimarySlot(opp);
  const sdg = opp.sdg_info?.sdg_target?.goal_index;
  const sdgs = typeof sdg === "number" ? [sdg] : [];

  return {
    id: `opp-${opp.id}`,
    slug: `${opp.id}-${slugify(opp.title ?? "opportunity")}`,
    title: opp.title ?? "Untitled opportunity",
    description: buildDescription(opp),
    image: opp.cover_photo?.url ?? "/hero/hero_static_default.png",
    alt: "",
    sdgs,
    startDate: slot?.start_date ?? opp.earliest_start_date ?? "",
    endDate: slot?.end_date ?? opp.latest_end_date ?? "",
    city: opp.host_lc?.name ?? "",
    category: mapCategory(opp),
    isOpen: opp.status === "open" && (opp.available_openings ?? 0) > 0,
  };
}

$groupTransformContent = @'
import type { GroupedProject, ProjectCategory } from "./grouped-types";
import type { GisOpportunity } from "./gis-types";

function slugify(value: string) {
  return value
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/&/g, "and")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/(^-|-$)+/g, "");
}

function mapCategory(opp: GisOpportunity): ProjectCategory {
  const id = opp.programme?.id;

  if (id === "7") return "volunteer"; // GV
  if (id === "8") return "talent";    // GTa
  if (id === "9") return "teaching";  // GTe

  return "volunteer";
}

function pickPrimarySlot(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  const slots = opp.all_slots?.nodes ?? [];
  return slots.find((slot) => slot.status === "live") ?? slots[0] ?? null;
}

function buildDescription(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  const base = (opp.description ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  const logistics = [];
  if (opp.logistics_info?.accommodation_covered === "covered") logistics.push("accommodation");
  if (opp.logistics_info?.food_covered === "covered") logistics.push("meals");
  if (opp.logistics_info?.transportation_covered === "covered") logistics.push("transportation");

  const extras = [];
  if (logistics.length > 0) extras.push(`Includes: ${logistics.join(", ")}.`);
  if (opp.fee_and_health_insurance?.total) {
    extras.push(`Programme fee: ${opp.fee_and_health_insurance.total} ${opp.fee_and_health_insurance.currency ?? ""}.`.trim());
  }

  return [base, ...extras].filter(Boolean).join(" ").trim();
}

function getProgrammeDisplay(
  programme: { id: string; short_name: string | null } | null | undefined
) {
  const p = programme as
    | ({ id: string; short_name: string | null; short_name_display?: string | null })
    | null
    | undefined;

  return p?.short_name_display ?? p?.short_name ?? "";
}

export function transformGisOpportunityToGrouped(opp: GisOpportunity): GroupedProject {
  const slot = pickPrimarySlot(opp);
  const sdg = opp.sdg_info?.sdg_target?.goal_index;
  const sdgs = typeof sdg === "number" ? [sdg] : [];

  return {
    id: `opp-${opp.id}`,
    slug: `${opp.id}-${slugify(opp.title ?? "opportunity")}`,
    title: opp.title ?? "Untitled opportunity",
    description: buildDescription(opp),
    image: opp.cover_photo?.url ?? "/hero/hero_static_default.png",
    alt: "",
    sdgs,
    startDate: slot?.start_date ?? opp.earliest_start_date ?? "",
    endDate: slot?.end_date ?? opp.latest_end_date ?? "",
    city: opp.host_lc?.name ?? "",
    category: mapCategory(opp),
    programme: getProgrammeDisplay(opp.programme),
    isOpen: opp.status === "open" && (opp.available_openings ?? 0) > 0,
  };
}

}) {

export async function generateMetadata({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ locale: string; slug: string }>;
}): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const projects = await loadGroupedProjects();
  const project = projects.find((p) => p.slug === slug);

  return {

    description: project.description.slice(0, 160),
  };
}

function fmtDate(iso: string | null): string {
  if (!iso) return "TBC";
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

const categoryColors: Record<string, string> = {

  cultural:   "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-100",
};

function SlotRow({ slot, index }: { slot: ProjectSlot; index: number }) {
  const hasDate = slot.startDate || slot.endDate;

      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-700">
        <Calendar size={13} className="text-gray-400 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
        {hasDate ? (
          <span>
            <span className="font-medium">{fmtDate(slot.startDate)}</span>
            <span className="text-gray-400 mx-1">â€”</span>
            <span className="font-medium">{fmtDate(slot.endDate)}</span>
          </span>
        ) : (
          <span className="text-gray-400 italic">Dates to be confirmed</span>
        )}
      </div>
      {slot.openings != null && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-gray-500 shrink-0">
          <Users size={11} aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>{slot.openings} slots</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { loadRawOpportunities } from "@/lib/projects/loader";
import { transformGisOpportunity } from "@/lib/projects/transform";

function csvEscape(value: unknown): string {
  const str = value == null ? "" : String(value);
  return `"${str.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
}

function getProgrammeDisplay(
  programme: { id: string; short_name: string | null } | null | undefined
) {
  const p = programme as
    | ({ id: string; short_name: string | null; short_name_display?: string | null })
    | null
    | undefined;

  return p?.short_name_display ?? p?.short_name ?? "";
}

export async function GET() {
  if (process.env.APP_ENV === "production" || process.env.APP_ENV === undefined) {
    return new NextResponse(null, { status: 404 });
  }

  const raw = await loadRawOpportunities();
  const transformed = raw.map(transformGisOpportunity);
  const active = transformed.filter((project) => project.isOpen);

  const programmeByRawId = new Map(
    raw.map((opp) => [String(opp.id), getProgrammeDisplay(opp.programme)])
  );

  const getProgrammeForTransformedId = (id: string) =>
    programmeByRawId.get(String(id).replace(/^opp-/, "")) ?? "";

  const headers = [
    "id",
    "slug",
    "title",
    "programme",
    "isOpen",
    "startDate",
    "endDate",
    "city",
    "category",
    "sdgs",
    "description",
  ];

  const lines = [
    headers.join(","),
    ...active.map((project) =>
      [
        csvEscape(project.id),
        csvEscape(project.slug),
        csvEscape(project.title),
        csvEscape(getProgrammeForTransformedId(project.id)),
        csvEscape(project.isOpen ? "open" : "closed"),
        csvEscape(project.startDate ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.endDate ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.city ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.category ?? ""),
        csvEscape(Array.isArray(project.sdgs) ? project.sdgs.join("|") : ""),
        csvEscape(project.description ?? ""),
      ].join(",")
    ),
  ];

  return new NextResponse(lines.join("\n"), {
    status: 200,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8",
      "Cache-Control": "no-store",
      "Content-Disposition": 'attachment; filename="active-projects.csv"',
    },
  });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";

/**
 * Currency conversion route.
 *
 * Primary source: open.er-api.com â€” free tier, no API key, supports TND.
 * Endpoint: https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/TND
 * Returns rates as: 1 TND = X foreign currency (i.e. rates[USD] â‰ˆ 0.32)
 *
 * Fallback: static rates below (same direction: 1 TND â†’ foreign).
 * Update these periodically if the API is unavailable for extended periods.
 */

// 1 TND expressed in each foreign currency (how much foreign you get per 1 TND)
const STATIC_RATES_FROM_TND: Record<string, number> = {
  USD: 0.322,
  EUR: 0.303,
  GBP: 0.256,
  CAD: 0.438,
  AUD: 0.500,
  CHF: 0.290,
  JPY: 47.6,
  CNY: 2.33,
  INR: 26.9,
  MAD: 3.22,
  DZD: 43.5,
  EGP: 15.6,
  SAR: 1.21,
  AED: 1.18,
  TRY: 10.4,
  BRL: 1.61,
  MXN: 5.56,
  ZAR: 5.88,
  KRW: 435.0,
  SGD: 0.435,
};

interface RateCache {
  rates: Record<string, number>; // 1 TND â†’ foreign
  ts: number;
  source: "live" | "static";
}

let cache: RateCache | null = null;
const CACHE_TTL = 3_600_000; // 1 hour

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// In-memory rate limiter (per IP)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

interface RateLimitEntry {
  count: number;
  windowStart: number;
}

const rateLimitMap = new Map<string, RateLimitEntry>();
const RATE_LIMIT_MAX = 30;       // max requests per window
const RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW = 60_000; // 1 minute window

/** Returns true if the request should be blocked. */
function isRateLimited(ip: string): boolean {
  const now = Date.now();
  const entry = rateLimitMap.get(ip);

  if (!entry || now - entry.windowStart > RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW) {
    rateLimitMap.set(ip, { count: 1, windowStart: now });
    return false;
  }

  entry.count += 1;
  if (entry.count > RATE_LIMIT_MAX) return true;

  return false;
}

/** Best-effort IP extraction â€” works on Vercel and standard proxies. */
function getClientIp(req: NextRequest): string {
  return (
    req.headers.get("x-forwarded-for")?.split(",")[0].trim() ??
    req.headers.get("x-real-ip") ??
    "unknown"
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Rate fetch
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function getRatesFromTND(): Promise<RateCache> {
  if (cache && Date.now() - cache.ts < CACHE_TTL) return cache;

  try {
    const res = await fetch("https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/TND", {
      next: { revalidate: 3600 },
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`open.er-api.com responded ${res.status}`);
    const json = await res.json();
    if (json.result !== "success" || !json.rates) throw new Error("unexpected response shape");

    cache = { rates: json.rates as Record<string, number>, ts: Date.now(), source: "live" };
    return cache;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[currency route] live fetch failed, using static rates:", err);
    cache = { rates: STATIC_RATES_FROM_TND, ts: Date.now(), source: "static" };
    return cache;
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Handler
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const ip = getClientIp(req);

  if (isRateLimited(ip)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Too many requests" },
      {
        status: 429,
        headers: { "Retry-After": "60" },
      }
    );
  }

  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const from   = (searchParams.get("from")   ?? "EUR").toUpperCase();
  const to     = (searchParams.get("to")     ?? "TND").toUpperCase();
  const amount = parseFloat(searchParams.get("amount") ?? "1");

  if (isNaN(amount) || amount < 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid amount" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const { rates, source } = await getRatesFromTND();

    // All rates are expressed as: 1 TND = rates[X] X
    // So: 1 X = 1 / rates[X] TND

    let amountInTND: number;
    if (from === "TND") {
      amountInTND = amount;
    } else {
      const fromRate = rates[from];
      if (!fromRate) return NextResponse.json({ error: `Unsupported currency: ${from}` }, { status: 400 });
      amountInTND = amount / fromRate;
    }

    let result: number;
    if (to === "TND") {
      result = amountInTND;
    } else {
      const toRate = rates[to];
      if (!toRate) return NextResponse.json({ error: `Unsupported currency: ${to}` }, { status: 400 });
      result = amountInTND * toRate;
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      from,
      to,
      amount,
      result: parseFloat(result.toFixed(4)),
      source,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Currency conversion unavailable" }, { status: 503 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import type { WeatherData, WeatherDay } from "@/lib/weather-types";

/**
 * Weather route â€” Open-Meteo (free, no API key required).
 *
 * Le Bardo, Tunisia (suburb of Tunis):
 *   Latitude:  36.8190Â°N
 *   Longitude: 10.1390Â°E
 * Source: Open-Meteo geocoding API confirmed these coordinates for "Le Bardo".
 *
 * Server-side cached for 30 minutes via Next.js fetch cache.
 */

const LAT = 36.819;
const LON = 10.139;
const CITY = "Le Bardo";

const OPEN_METEO_URL =
  `https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast` +
  `?latitude=${LAT}&longitude=${LON}` +
  `&current=temperature_2m,apparent_temperature,weather_code,wind_speed_10m,relative_humidity_2m` +
  `&daily=temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,weather_code` +
  `&timezone=Africa%2FTunis` +
  `&forecast_days=7`;

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(OPEN_METEO_URL, { next: { revalidate: 1800 } });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Open-Meteo responded ${res.status}`);

    const raw = await res.json() as {
      current: {
        temperature_2m: number;
        apparent_temperature: number;
        weather_code: number;
        wind_speed_10m: number;
        relative_humidity_2m: number;
      };
      daily: {
        time: string[];
        temperature_2m_max: number[];
        temperature_2m_min: number[];
        weather_code: number[];
      };
    };

    const forecast: WeatherDay[] = raw.daily.time.map((date, i) => ({
      date,
      maxTemp: Math.round(raw.daily.temperature_2m_max[i]),
      minTemp: Math.round(raw.daily.temperature_2m_min[i]),
      weatherCode: raw.daily.weather_code[i],
    }));

    const data: WeatherData = {
      city: CITY,
      temperature: Math.round(raw.current.temperature_2m),
      apparentTemperature: Math.round(raw.current.apparent_temperature),
      humidity: Math.round(raw.current.relative_humidity_2m),
      windSpeed: Math.round(raw.current.wind_speed_10m),
      weatherCode: raw.current.weather_code,
      forecast,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    return NextResponse.json(data);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[weather route]", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Weather data unavailable" }, { status: 503 });
  }
}

"use client";

import { useState, useCallback } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { Menu, X, Globe } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { locales, localeNames, type Locale } from "@/i18n/config";

export function Navbar({ isProduction = false }: { isProduction?: boolean }) {
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const t = useTranslations("nav");

  const segments = pathname.split("/");
  const currentLocale = (locales.includes(segments[1] as Locale) ? segments[1] : "en") as Locale;

  const localePath = (path: string) => `/${currentLocale}${path}`;

  const allNavLinks = [
    { href: localePath(""), label: t("home"), productionVisible: true },
    { href: localePath("/discover-bardo"), label: t("discover"), productionVisible: false },
    { href: localePath("/our-projects"), label: t("projects"), productionVisible: true },
    { href: localePath("/tunisian-lifestyle"), label: t("lifestyle"), productionVisible: false },
    { href: localePath("/faq"), label: t("faq"), productionVisible: false },
  ];

  const navLinks = isProduction
    ? allNavLinks.filter((l) => l.productionVisible)
    : allNavLinks;

  const isActive = (href: string) => {
    const base = `/${currentLocale}`;
    if (href === base || href === `${base}/`) return pathname === base || pathname === `${base}/`;
    return pathname.startsWith(href);
  };

  const openPicker = useCallback(() => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("open-language-picker"));
    setMenuOpen(false);
  }, []);

  return (
    <header className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur border-b border-gray-100">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between h-20">
          <Link
            href={localePath("")}
            className="flex items-center gap-3 focus-ring rounded-md"
            aria-label={t("logoLabel")}
          >
            <img src="/logos/aiesec-human-blue.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" className="h-10 w-auto" />
            <span className="text-gray-900 font-semibold text-[1.05rem] tracking-tight">in Bardo</span>
          </Link>

          <nav aria-label={t("mainNav")} className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-2">
            {navLinks.map((link) => (
              <Link
                key={link.href}
                href={link.href}
                className={cn(
                  "text-base transition-colors duration-150 focus-ring rounded-md px-4 py-2",
                  isActive(link.href)
                    ? "text-gray-900 font-medium"
                    : "text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-900"
                )}
                aria-current={isActive(link.href) ? "page" : undefined}
              >
                {link.label}
              </Link>
            ))}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={openPicker}
              aria-label={t("changeLanguageLabel")}
              title={t("changeLanguage")}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-900 transition-colors focus-ring rounded-md px-4 py-2 ml-1"
            >
              <Globe size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
              <span className="uppercase text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide">{currentLocale}</span>
            </button>

            <Link
              href={localePath("/our-projects")}
              className="ml-4 px-6 py-3 rounded-full bg-accent text-white text-base font-semibold hover:bg-[var(--accent-dark)] transition-colors duration-150 focus-ring"
            >
              {t("applyNow")}
            </Link>
          </nav>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setMenuOpen((v) => !v)}
            aria-expanded={menuOpen}
            aria-controls="mobile-menu"
            aria-label={menuOpen ? t("closeMenu") : t("openMenu")}
            className="md:hidden p-2 rounded-md text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-900 focus-ring"
          >
            {menuOpen ? <X size={22} /> : <Menu size={22} />}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {menuOpen && (
        <nav
          id="mobile-menu"
          aria-label={t("mobileNav")}
          className="md:hidden bg-white border-t border-gray-100"
        >
          <ul className="flex flex-col px-4 py-4 gap-1">
            {navLinks.map((link) => (
              <li key={link.href}>
                <Link
                  href={link.href}
                  onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}
                  aria-current={isActive(link.href) ? "page" : undefined}
                  className={cn(
                    "block py-3 text-base transition-colors focus-ring rounded-md px-2",
                    isActive(link.href)
                      ? "text-gray-900 font-medium"
                      : "text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-900"
                  )}
                >
                  {link.label}
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
            <li className="pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 mt-2">
              <div className="flex gap-2 py-1">
                {locales.map((loc) => (
                  <Link
                    key={loc}
                    href={`/${loc}${pathname.substring(currentLocale.length + 1)}`}
                    onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}
                    className={cn(
                      "flex-1 text-center py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold border transition-colors focus-ring",
                      loc === currentLocale
                        ? "bg-accent text-white border-accent"
                        : "text-gray-500 border-gray-200 hover:text-gray-900"
                    )}
                  >
                    {localeNames[loc]}
                  </Link>
                ))}
              </div>
            </li>
            <li className="pt-3 pb-1">
              <Link
                href={localePath("/our-projects")}
                onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}
                className="block text-center px-4 py-3 rounded-full bg-accent text-white text-base font-semibold hover:bg-[var(--accent-dark)] transition-colors focus-ring"
              >
                {t("applyNow")}
              </Link>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </nav>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}

function Write-TextFile($path, $content) {

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null
  }
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $content, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
  Write-Host "[written] $path" -ForegroundColor Green
}

Write-Section "Replacing projects client with selector-first flow"
$projectsClientContent = @'
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import type { GroupedProject } from "@/lib/projects/grouped-types";
import { ProjectFilters } from "./ProjectFilters";
import { GroupedProjectGrid } from "./GroupedProjectGrid";
import { ProjectCategorySelector } from "./ProjectCategorySelector";
import { filterProjects, type FilterState } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { SDG } from "@/data/projects";

const DEFAULT_FILTERS: FilterState = {
  category: "all",
  sdgs: [],
  city: "all",
  status: "all",
  startDate: "",
  endDate: "",
};

interface ProjectsPageClientProps {
  projects: GroupedProject[];
  locale: string;
}

function normalizeCategory(value: string | null): FilterState["category"] | null {
  if (value === "volunteer" || value === "internship" || value === "cultural") {
    return value;
  }
  return null;
}

export function ProjectsPageClient({ projects, locale }: ProjectsPageClientProps) {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const selectedCategory = normalizeCategory(searchParams.get("category"));
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<FilterState>(DEFAULT_FILTERS);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedCategory) {
      setFilters({
        ...DEFAULT_FILTERS,
        category: selectedCategory,
      });
    } else {
      setFilters(DEFAULT_FILTERS);
    }
  }, [selectedCategory]);

  const availableSdgs = useMemo(
    () =>
      Array.from(new Set(projects.flatMap((project) => project.sdgs))).sort(
        (a, b) => a - b
      ) as SDG[],
    [projects]
  );

  const filtered = useMemo(
    () => filterProjects(projects, filters),
    [projects, filters]
  );

  const resetHref = `/${locale}/our-projects`;

  if (!selectedCategory) {
    return <ProjectCategorySelector projects={projects} locale={locale} />;
  }

  return (
    <section aria-label="Projects listing" className="py-16 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-col gap-8">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="text-accent text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.22em] mb-3">
              Category selected
            </p>
            <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-gray-900 leading-tight capitalize">
              {selectedCategory} projects
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-3 text-gray-500 text-sm sm:text-base max-w-2xl leading-relaxed">
              The filter bar below is still active, so you can refine this category further.
            </p>
          </div>

          <a
            href={resetHref}
            className="inline-flex items-center justify-center px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full border border-gray-200 text-gray-700 text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors focus-ring"
          >
            Back to selection
          </a>
        </div>

        <ProjectFilters
          filters={filters}
          availableSdgs={availableSdgs}
          onChange={setFilters}
        />

        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-medium tabular-nums">
          {filtered.length} project{filtered.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} found
        </p>

        <GroupedProjectGrid
          projects={filtered}
          locale={locale}
          onReset={() => setFilters({ ...DEFAULT_FILTERS, category: selectedCategory })}
        />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "framer-motion";
import { ChatPanel, type ChatMessage } from "./ChatPanel";
import { knowledgeBase, FALLBACK_MESSAGE } from "@/data/knowledge-base";
import { matchFaq } from "@/lib/utils";
import { AiesecHuman } from "@/components/ui/AiesecHuman";

let msgCounter = 0;
function makeId() {
  return `msg-${++msgCounter}-${Date.now()}`;
}

const WELCOME_MESSAGE: ChatMessage = {
  id: "welcome",
  role: "agent",
  text: "ðŸ‘‹ Hi! I'm the Bardo Assistant. Ask me anything about Tunisia, AIESEC exchanges, or the cost of living. How can I help?",
  timestamp: new Date(),
};

export function ChatAgent() {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([WELCOME_MESSAGE]);

  const handleToggle = useCallback(() => {
    setIsOpen((v) => !v);
  }, []);

  const handleClose = useCallback(() => {
    setIsOpen(false);
  }, []);

  const handleSend = useCallback((text: string) => {
    const userMsg: ChatMessage = {
      id: makeId(),
      role: "user",
      text,
      timestamp: new Date(),
    };

    const match = matchFaq(text, knowledgeBase);
    const agentMsg: ChatMessage = {
      id: makeId(),
      role: "agent",
      text: match ? match.answer : FALLBACK_MESSAGE,
      timestamp: new Date(),
    };

    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, userMsg, agentMsg]);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 flex flex-col items-end" style={{ display: "none" }} aria-hidden="true">
      {/* Chat panel */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isOpen && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16, scale: 0.95 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 16, scale: 0.95 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: "easeOut" }}
          >
            <ChatPanel
              isOpen={isOpen}
              onClose={handleClose}
              messages={messages}
              onSend={handleSend}
            />
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Floating trigger â€” AIESEC Human mark */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleToggle}
        aria-label={isOpen ? "Close chat assistant" : "Open chat assistant"}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        className="mt-3 animate-float focus-ring rounded-full shadow-xl shadow-accent/30 hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-200"
      >
        <AiesecHuman size={48} />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { X, Send } from "lucide-react";

export interface ChatMessage {
  id: string;
  role: "user" | "agent";
  text: string;
  timestamp: Date;
}

interface ChatPanelProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  messages: ChatMessage[];
  onSend: (text: string) => void;
}

export function ChatPanel({ isOpen, onClose, messages, onSend }: ChatPanelProps) {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Focus input when panel opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Scroll to bottom on new messages
  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  }, [messages]);

  // Focus trap + Escape key
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        onClose();
        return;
      }

      if (e.key !== "Tab") return;

      const panel = panelRef.current;
      if (!panel) return;

      const focusable = panel.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
        'button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
      );
      const first = focusable[0];
      const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];

      if (e.shiftKey) {
        if (document.activeElement === first) {
          e.preventDefault();
          last.focus();
        }
      } else {
        if (document.activeElement === last) {
          e.preventDefault();
          first.focus();
        }
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const input = inputRef.current;
    if (!input || !input.value.trim()) return;
    onSend(input.value.trim());
    input.value = "";
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      ref={panelRef}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Chat with AIESEC in Bardo"
      className="absolute bottom-20 right-0 w-80 sm:w-96 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden"
      style={{ maxHeight: "480px" }}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b border-gray-100 bg-white">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[var(--accent)] animate-pulse" />
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">Bardo Assistant</span>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label="Close chat"
          className="p-1 rounded-md text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors focus-ring"
        >
          <X size={16} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Messages */}
      <ul
        role="log"
        aria-live="polite"
        aria-label="Chat messages"
        className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-4 flex flex-col gap-3 min-h-0"
        style={{ maxHeight: "320px" }}
      >
        {messages.map((msg) => (
          <li
            key={msg.id}
            className={`flex ${msg.role === "user" ? "justify-end" : "justify-start"}`}
          >
            <div
              className={`max-w-[80%] rounded-2xl px-3 py-2 text-sm leading-relaxed ${
                msg.role === "user"
                  ? "bg-accent text-white rounded-br-sm"
                  : "bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 rounded-bl-sm"
              }`}
            >
              {msg.text}
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
        <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
      </ul>

      {/* Input */}
      <form
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-3 border-t border-gray-100"
      >
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          type="text"
          placeholder="Ask about Tunisia, costs, AIESEC..."
          aria-label="Type your message"
          className="flex-1 bg-[var(--section-alt)] text-gray-900 text-sm rounded-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-200 placeholder-gray-400 focus-ring focus:outline-none"
        />
        <button
          type="submit"
          aria-label="Send message"
          className="p-2 rounded-full bg-accent text-white hover:bg-[var(--accent-dark)] transition-colors focus-ring flex-shrink-0"
        >
          <Send size={14} />
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useRef, useState, useCallback, KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { ChevronDown } from "lucide-react";
import type { FaqEntry } from "@/data/faq";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface FaqAccordionProps {
  entries: FaqEntry[];
}

interface AccordionItemProps {
  entry: FaqEntry;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onKeyDown: (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void;
  index: number;
}

function AccordionItem({ entry, isOpen, onToggle, onKeyDown }: AccordionItemProps) {
  const contentRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const panelId = `faq-panel-${entry.id}`;
  const triggerId = `faq-trigger-${entry.id}`;

  const contentHeight = isOpen && contentRef.current
    ? contentRef.current.scrollHeight
    : 0;

  return (
    <div className="border-b border-gray-100 last:border-b-0">
      <h3>
        <button
          id={triggerId}
          type="button"
          aria-expanded={isOpen}
          aria-controls={panelId}
          onClick={onToggle}
          onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
          className="w-full flex items-center justify-between gap-4 py-5 text-left text-gray-900 font-medium text-sm sm:text-base focus-ring rounded-md"
        >
          <span>{entry.question}</span>
          <ChevronDown
            size={16}
            aria-hidden="true"
            className={cn(
              "flex-shrink-0 text-gray-400 transition-transform duration-300",
              isOpen && "rotate-180"
            )}
          />
        </button>
      </h3>
      <div
        id={panelId}
        role="region"
        aria-labelledby={triggerId}
        ref={contentRef}
        style={{
          maxHeight: isOpen ? contentHeight || "none" : 0,
          opacity: isOpen ? 1 : 0,
        }}
        className="overflow-hidden transition-[max-height,opacity] duration-300 ease-in-out"
      >
        <p className="pb-5 text-gray-500 text-sm leading-relaxed">
          {entry.answer}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function FaqAccordion({ entries }: FaqAccordionProps) {
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const toggle = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setOpenId((prev) => (prev === id ? null : id));
  }, []);

  const handleKeyDown = useCallback(
    (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, index: number) => {
      if (!listRef.current) return;
      const buttons = Array.from(
        listRef.current.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("button[aria-expanded]")
      );
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
        e.preventDefault();
        buttons[(index + 1) % buttons.length]?.focus();
      } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
        e.preventDefault();
        buttons[(index - 1 + buttons.length) % buttons.length]?.focus();
      } else if (e.key === "Home") {
        e.preventDefault();
        buttons[0]?.focus();
      } else if (e.key === "End") {
        e.preventDefault();
        buttons[buttons.length - 1]?.focus();
      }
    },
    []
  );

  if (entries.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="py-16 text-center">
        <div className="text-4xl mb-3" aria-hidden="true">ðŸ¤”</div>
        <p className="text-gray-900 font-semibold mb-1">No results found</p>
        <p className="text-gray-500 text-sm">Try a different search term or category.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      ref={listRef}
      className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-sm divide-y divide-gray-100 px-5"
    >
      {entries.map((entry, i) => (
        <AccordionItem
          key={entry.id}
          entry={entry}
          index={i}
          isOpen={openId === entry.id}
          onToggle={() => toggle(entry.id)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => handleKeyDown(e, i)}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { faqEntries, type FaqTopic } from "@/data/faq";
import { FaqSearch } from "./FaqSearch";
import { FaqCategoryTabs } from "./FaqCategoryTabs";
import { FaqAccordion } from "./FaqAccordion";

type TabValue = FaqTopic | "all";

export function FaqPageClient() {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<TabValue>("all");

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.toLowerCase().trim();
    return faqEntries.filter((entry) => {
      const matchesCategory = category === "all" || entry.topic === category;
      const matchesQuery =
        !q ||
        entry.question.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        entry.keywords.some((kw) => kw.toLowerCase().includes(q));
      return matchesCategory && matchesQuery;
    });
  }, [query, category]);

  return (
    <section aria-label="FAQ" className="py-24 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto flex flex-col gap-6">
        <FaqSearch value={query} onChange={setQuery} />
        <FaqCategoryTabs active={category} onChange={setCategory} />
        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-medium tabular-nums">
          {filtered.length} result{filtered.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}
        </p>
        <FaqAccordion entries={filtered} />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

      />

          type="button"
          onClick={() => onChange("")}

"use client";

import { useState, useCallback } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { Menu, X, Globe } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { locales, localeNames, type Locale } from "@/i18n/config";

export function Navbar({ isProduction = false }: { isProduction?: boolean }) {
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const t = useTranslations("nav");

  const segments = pathname.split("/");
  const currentLocale = (locales.includes(segments[1] as Locale) ? segments[1] : "en") as Locale;

  const localePath = (path: string) => `/${currentLocale}${path}`;

  const allNavLinks = [
    { href: localePath(""), label: t("home"), productionVisible: true },
    { href: localePath("/discover-bardo"), label: t("discover"), productionVisible: false },
    { href: localePath("/our-projects"), label: t("projects"), productionVisible: true },
    { href: localePath("/tunisian-lifestyle"), label: t("lifestyle"), productionVisible: false },
    { href: localePath("/faq"), label: t("faq"), productionVisible: false },
  ];

  const navLinks = isProduction
    ? allNavLinks.filter((l) => l.productionVisible)
    : allNavLinks;

  const isActive = (href: string) => {
    const base = `/${currentLocale}`;
    if (href === base || href === `${base}/`) return pathname === base || pathname === `${base}/`;
    return pathname.startsWith(href);
  };

  const openPicker = useCallback(() => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("open-language-picker"));
    setMenuOpen(false);
  }, []);

  return (
    <header className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur border-b border-gray-100">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between h-20">
          <Link
            href={localePath("")}
            className="flex items-center gap-3 focus-ring rounded-md"
            aria-label={t("logoLabel")}
          >
            <img src="/logos/aiesec-human-blue.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" className="h-10 w-auto" />
            <span className="text-gray-900 font-semibold text-[1.05rem] tracking-tight">in Bardo</span>
          </Link>

          <nav aria-label={t("mainNav")} className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-2">
            {navLinks.map((link) => (
              <Link
                key={link.href}
                href={link.href}
                className={cn(
                  "text-base transition-colors duration-150 focus-ring rounded-md px-4 py-2",
                  isActive(link.href)
                    ? "text-gray-900 font-medium"
                    : "text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-900"
                )}
                aria-current={isActive(link.href) ? "page" : undefined}
              >
                {link.label}
              </Link>
            ))}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={openPicker}
              aria-label={t("changeLanguageLabel")}
              title={t("changeLanguage")}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-900 transition-colors focus-ring rounded-md px-4 py-2 ml-1"
            >
              <Globe size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
              <span className="uppercase text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide">{currentLocale}</span>
            </button>

            <Link
              href={localePath("/our-projects")}
              className="ml-4 px-6 py-3 rounded-full bg-accent text-white text-base font-semibold hover:bg-[var(--accent-dark)] transition-colors duration-150 focus-ring"
            >
              {t("applyNow")}
            </Link>
          </nav>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setMenuOpen((v) => !v)}
            aria-expanded={menuOpen}
            aria-controls="mobile-menu"
            aria-label={menuOpen ? t("closeMenu") : t("openMenu")}
            className="md:hidden p-2 rounded-md text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-900 focus-ring"
          >
            {menuOpen ? <X size={22} /> : <Menu size={22} />}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {menuOpen && (
        <nav
          id="mobile-menu"
          aria-label={t("mobileNav")}
          className="md:hidden bg-white border-t border-gray-100"
        >
          <ul className="flex flex-col px-4 py-4 gap-1">
            {navLinks.map((link) => (
              <li key={link.href}>
                <Link
                  href={link.href}
                  onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}
                  aria-current={isActive(link.href) ? "page" : undefined}
                  className={cn(
                    "block py-3 text-base transition-colors focus-ring rounded-md px-2",
                    isActive(link.href)
                      ? "text-gray-900 font-medium"
                      : "text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-900"
                  )}
                >
                  {link.label}
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
            <li className="pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 mt-2">
              <div className="flex gap-2 py-1">
                {locales.map((loc) => (
                  <Link
                    key={loc}
                    href={`/${loc}${pathname.substring(currentLocale.length + 1)}`}
                    onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}
                    className={cn(
                      "flex-1 text-center py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold border transition-colors focus-ring",
                      loc === currentLocale
                        ? "bg-accent text-white border-accent"
                        : "text-gray-500 border-gray-200 hover:text-gray-900"
                    )}
                  >
                    {localeNames[loc]}
                  </Link>
                ))}
              </div>
            </li>
            <li className="pt-3 pb-1">
              <Link
                href={localePath("/our-projects")}
                onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}
                className="block text-center px-4 py-3 rounded-full bg-accent text-white text-base font-semibold hover:bg-[var(--accent-dark)] transition-colors focus-ring"
              >
                {t("applyNow")}
              </Link>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </nav>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}

function wmoEmoji(code: number): string {
  if (code === 0) return "â˜€ï¸";
  if (code <= 2)  return "â›…";
  if (code === 3) return "â˜ï¸";
  if (code <= 49) return "ðŸŒ«ï¸";
  if (code <= 59) return "ðŸŒ¦ï¸";
  if (code <= 69) return "ðŸŒ§ï¸";
  if (code <= 79) return "â„ï¸";
  if (code <= 82) return "ðŸŒ§ï¸";
  if (code <= 84) return "ðŸŒ¨ï¸";
  if (code <= 99) return "â›ˆï¸";
  return "ðŸŒ¡ï¸";
}

function wmoLabel(code: number): string {
  if (code === 0) return "Clear sky";
  if (code <= 2)  return "Partly cloudy";
  if (code === 3) return "Overcast";
  if (code <= 49) return "Foggy";
  if (code <= 59) return "Drizzle";
  if (code <= 69) return "Rain";
  if (code <= 79) return "Snow";
  if (code <= 82) return "Rain showers";
  if (code <= 84) return "Snow showers";
  if (code <= 99) return "Thunderstorm";
  return "Unknown";
}

function formatDay(dateStr: string): string {
  const d = new Date(dateStr + "T12:00:00");
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" });
}

export function ClimateSection() {
  const [weather, setWeather] = useState<WeatherData | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState(false);
  const [stale, setStale] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const fetchWeather = useCallback((isRetry = false) => {
    if (isRetry) { setLoading(true); setError(false); }
    fetch("/api/weather")
      .then((r) => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error("failed"); return r.json() as Promise<WeatherData>; })
      .then((data) => { setWeather(data); setStale(false); setError(false); setLoading(false); })
      .catch(() => {
        setError(true);
        setLoading(false);
        // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
        if (weather) setStale(true);
      });
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { fetchWeather(); }, [fetchWeather]);

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="climate-heading" className="py-24 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 bg-white">
