"use client";

/**
 * WorldMap â€” real 2D world map using react-simple-maps + world-atlas TopoJSON.
 *
 * Features:
 * - Neutral light base map (all countries)
 * - Partner countries filled in #037EF3
 * - Tunisia highlighted in brand accent #ff3131 with pulsing hub marker
 * - Animated curved arcs from Tunisia to each partner country
 * - Arc colors cycle through brand palette: #F85A40 Â· #F48924 Â· #0CB9C1
 * - Responsive SVG, mobile-friendly
 * - Respects prefers-reduced-motion
 */

import { useReducedMotion, motion } from "framer-motion";
import { ComposableMap, Geographies, Geography, Marker } from "react-simple-maps";
import { geoInterpolate } from "d3-geo";
import { partnerCountries, partnerCountryIds, TUNISIA } from "@/data/partner-countries";

const GEO_URL = "/world-110m.json";

// â”€â”€â”€ Colors â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
const COLOR_BASE     = "#e8edf2"; // neutral light grey for non-partner countries
const COLOR_PARTNER  = "#037EF3"; // partner country fill
const COLOR_PARTNER_STROKE = "#ffffff";
const COLOR_TUNISIA  = "#ff3131"; // brand accent â€” hub
const COLOR_BORDER   = "#ffffff"; // country border

// â”€â”€â”€ Arc helpers â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

/**
 * Build a smooth SVG cubic-bezier arc between two [lng, lat] points
 * projected onto the map's coordinate space.
 *
 * We use geoInterpolate to get the great-circle midpoint, then lift it
 * toward the center of the map to create a natural arc curve.
 */
function buildArcPath(
  fromCoords: [number, number],
  toCoords: [number, number],
  project: (coords: [number, number]) => [number, number]
): string {
  const [x1, y1] = project(fromCoords);
  const [x2, y2] = project(toCoords);

  // Great-circle midpoint
  const midCoords = geoInterpolate(fromCoords, toCoords)(0.5) as [number, number];
  const [mx, my] = project(midCoords);

  // Lift the control point toward the map center to create a visible arc
  // The lift amount scales with the distance between endpoints
  const dx = x2 - x1;
  const dy = y2 - y1;
  const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  const lift = Math.min(dist * 0.35, 80);

  // Perpendicular direction (rotate 90Â°)
  const len = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
  const cpx = mx - (dy / len) * lift;
  const cpy = my + (dx / len) * lift;

  return `M ${x1} ${y1} Q ${cpx} ${cpy} ${x2} ${y2}`;
}

// â”€â”€â”€ Arc component â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

interface ArcProps {
  from: [number, number];
  to: [number, number];
  color: string;
  project: (coords: [number, number]) => [number, number];
  delay: number;
  animate: boolean;
}

function Arc({ from, to, color, project, delay, animate }: ArcProps) {
  const d = buildArcPath(from, to, project);

  // Approximate path length for dash animation
  const DASH = 400;

  return (
    <motion.path
      d={d}
      fill="none"
      stroke={color}
      strokeWidth={1.2}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeOpacity={0.75}
      strokeDasharray={DASH}
      markerEnd={`url(#arrow-${color.replace("#", "")})`}
      initial={{ strokeDashoffset: DASH, opacity: 0 }}
      animate={
        animate
          ? { strokeDashoffset: 0, opacity: 1 }
          : { strokeDashoffset: DASH, opacity: 0 }
      }
      transition={{
        duration: 1.4,
        delay,
        ease: "easeInOut",
      }}
    />
  );
}

// â”€â”€â”€ Dot component â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

interface DotProps {
  coords: [number, number];
  color: string;
  project: (coords: [number, number]) => [number, number];
  delay: number;
  animate: boolean;
}

function Dot({ coords, color, project, delay, animate }: DotProps) {
  const [cx, cy] = project(coords);
  return (
    <motion.circle
      cx={cx}
      cy={cy}
      r={2.5}
      fill={color}
      initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0 }}
      animate={animate ? { opacity: 0.9, scale: 1 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.3, delay: delay + 1.2 }}
      style={{ transformOrigin: `${cx}px ${cy}px` }}
    />
  );
}

// â”€â”€â”€ Main component â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

interface WorldMapProps {
  isVisible: boolean;
}

export function WorldMap({ isVisible }: WorldMapProps) {
  const shouldReduceMotion = useReducedMotion();
  const animate = isVisible;

  // Map dimensions â€” wide aspect ratio for a section banner
  const WIDTH  = 800;
  const HEIGHT = 420;

  // We need to project coordinates ourselves for arcs.
  // react-simple-maps uses geoEqualEarth by default with scale ~160 at 800px wide.
  // We replicate the same projection here using d3-geo.
  // The projection function is called inside the Geographies render prop,
  // but we need it outside too for arcs. We'll use a manual geoEqualEarth setup.

  return (
    <div className="w-full" aria-label="World map showing AIESEC in Bardo global partner network" role="img">
      <ComposableMap
        width={WIDTH}
        height={HEIGHT}
        projection="geoEqualEarth"
        projectionConfig={{ scale: 153, center: [15, 15] }}
        style={{ width: "100%", height: "auto" }}
      >
        {/* â”€â”€ Arrow marker defs â”€â”€ */}
        <defs>
          {["F85A40", "F48924", "0CB9C1"].map((hex) => (
            <marker
              key={hex}
              id={`arrow-${hex}`}
              markerWidth="6"
              markerHeight="6"
              refX="5"
              refY="3"
              orient="auto"
            >
              <path d="M0,0 L0,6 L6,3 Z" fill={`#${hex}`} opacity={0.8} />
            </marker>
          ))}
        </defs>

        {/* â”€â”€ Base world countries â”€â”€ */}
        <Geographies geography={GEO_URL}>
          {({ geographies, projection }) => {
            // Build a typed project function from the d3 projection
            const project = (coords: [number, number]): [number, number] => {
              const pt = projection(coords);
              return pt ? [pt[0], pt[1]] : [0, 0];
            };

            const tunisiaXY = project(TUNISIA.coordinates);

            return (
              <>
                {/* Countries */}
                {geographies.map((geo) => {
                  const id = String(geo.id);
                  const isTunisia  = id === TUNISIA.id;
                  const isPartner  = partnerCountryIds.has(id);

                  return (
                    <Geography
                      key={geo.rsmKey}
                      geography={geo}
                      style={{
                        default: {
                          fill:        isTunisia ? COLOR_TUNISIA : isPartner ? COLOR_PARTNER : COLOR_BASE,
                          stroke:      COLOR_BORDER,
                          strokeWidth: 0.4,
                          outline:     "none",
                        },
                        hover: {
                          fill:        isTunisia ? COLOR_TUNISIA : isPartner ? "#0568c8" : "#d4dce6",
                          stroke:      COLOR_BORDER,
                          strokeWidth: 0.4,
                          outline:     "none",
                        },
                        pressed: { outline: "none" },
                      }}
                    />
                  );
                })}

                {/* Connection arcs â€” rendered after countries so they sit on top */}
                {!shouldReduceMotion &&
                  partnerCountries.map((partner, i) => (
                    <Arc
                      key={`arc-${partner.id}`}
                      from={TUNISIA.coordinates}
                      to={partner.coordinates}
                      color={partner.color}
                      project={project}
                      delay={i * 0.06}
                      animate={animate}
                    />
                  ))}

                {/* Destination dots */}
                {partnerCountries.map((partner, i) => (
                  <Dot
                    key={`dot-${partner.id}`}
                    coords={partner.coordinates}
                    color={partner.color}
                    project={project}
                    delay={i * 0.06}
                    animate={animate}
                  />
                ))}

                {/* Tunisia hub marker */}
                <Marker coordinates={TUNISIA.coordinates}>
                  {/* Outer pulse ring */}
                  <motion.circle
                    r={10}
                    fill="none"
                    stroke={COLOR_TUNISIA}
                    strokeWidth={1.5}
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.5 }}
                    animate={
                      animate
                        ? { opacity: [0, 0.5, 0], scale: [0.8, 1.8, 0.8] }
                        : { opacity: 0 }
                    }
                    transition={
                      shouldReduceMotion
                        ? { duration: 0.01 }
                        : { duration: 2.5, repeat: Infinity, ease: "easeInOut", delay: 1.5 }
                    }
                  />
                  {/* Inner dot */}
                  <motion.circle
                    r={5}
                    fill={COLOR_TUNISIA}
                    stroke="#ffffff"
                    strokeWidth={1.5}
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0 }}
                    animate={animate ? { opacity: 1, scale: 1 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0 }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.4, delay: 0.3 }}
                  />
                  {/* Label */}
                  <motion.text
                    textAnchor="middle"
                    y={-12}
                    style={{
                      fontFamily: "inherit",
                      fontSize: "7px",
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      fill: COLOR_TUNISIA,
                      letterSpacing: "0.08em",
                      textTransform: "uppercase",
                    }}
                    initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                    animate={animate ? { opacity: 1 } : { opacity: 0 }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.4, delay: 0.6 }}
                  >
                    BARDO
                  </motion.text>
                </Marker>
              </>
            );
          }}
        </Geographies>
      </ComposableMap>
    </div>
  );

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter, usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Globe } from "lucide-react";
import { locales, localeNames, type Locale } from "@/i18n/config";
import { hasCompletedOnboarding, saveLocaleAndCountry } from "@/lib/locale";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function CountryLanguagePicker() {
  const t = useTranslations("picker");
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();

  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("en");
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  // Detect current locale from pathname (/en/..., /fr/..., /ar/...)
  const currentLocale = (pathname.split("/")[1] as Locale) || "en";

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    if (!hasCompletedOnboarding()) {
      setVisible(true);
    }
  }, []);

  // Reopen handler â€” triggered via custom event from Navbar
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = () => setVisible(true);
    window.addEventListener("open-language-picker", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("open-language-picker", handler);
  }, []);

  const handleContinue = () => {
    saveLocaleAndCountry(locale);
    setVisible(false);
    // Signal DiscountOverlay to show after language is chosen
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("language-chosen"));

    if (locale !== currentLocale) {
      const segments = pathname.split("/");
      segments[1] = locale;
      router.push(segments.join("/") || `/${locale}`);
    }
  };

  if (!mounted || !visible) return null;

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="picker-heading"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center p-4"
    >
      {/* Backdrop */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm" aria-hidden="true" />

      {/* Panel */}
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-2xl p-8 flex flex-col gap-6">
        {/* Icon + heading */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 text-center">
          <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-accent/10 border border-accent/20 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Globe size={28} className="text-accent" aria-hidden="true" />
          </div>
          <h2 id="picker-heading" className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900">
            {t("heading")}
          </h2>
          <p className="text-gray-500 text-sm leading-relaxed">{t("subheading")}</p>
        </div>

        {/* Language select */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">{t("languageLabel")}</span>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {locales.map((loc) => (
              <button
                key={loc}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setLocale(loc)}
                aria-pressed={locale === loc}
                className={cn(
                  "flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl border text-sm font-medium transition-colors duration-150 focus-ring",
                  locale === loc
                    ? "bg-accent text-white border-accent"
                    : "bg-transparent text-gray-500 border-gray-200 hover:border-accent/50 hover:text-accent"
                )}
              >
                {localeNames[loc]}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Continue button */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleContinue}
          className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-semibold text-sm bg-accent text-white hover:bg-[var(--accent-dark)] transition-colors duration-150 focus-ring"
        >
          {t("continueButton")}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

 * Display logic (homepage only):
 *  - Always shows on every homepage load/reload.
 *  - First-time visitor: waits for "language-chosen" event, then shows after 600ms.
 *  - Returning visitor: shows after 900ms settle delay.
 *  - Dismissed via close button, "Got it", "Explore Now", or backdrop click.
 */

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { hasCompletedOnboarding } from "@/lib/locale";

export function DiscountOverlay() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  const dismiss = () => setVisible(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);

    if (!hasCompletedOnboarding()) {
      const onLanguageChosen = () => {
        setTimeout(() => setVisible(true), 600);
      };
      window.addEventListener("language-chosen", onLanguageChosen, { once: true });
      return () => window.removeEventListener("language-chosen", onLanguageChosen);
    } else {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setVisible(true), 900);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);

      role="dialog"

function fmtDate(iso: string | null): string {
  if (!iso) return "TBC";
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric" });
}

import { X } from "lucide-react";
import type { FilterState } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { SDG } from "@/data/projects";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

// SDG official colors (UN palette)
const SDG_COLORS: Record<SDG, { bg: string; text: string; border: string }> = {
  1:  { bg: "#E5243B", text: "#fff", border: "#E5243B" },
  2:  { bg: "#DDA63A", text: "#fff", border: "#DDA63A" },
  3:  { bg: "#4C9F38", text: "#fff", border: "#4C9F38" },

  8:  { bg: "#A21942", text: "#fff", border: "#A21942" },
  9:  { bg: "#FD6925", text: "#fff", border: "#FD6925" },
  10: { bg: "#DD1367", text: "#fff", border: "#DD1367" },
  11: { bg: "#FD9D24", text: "#fff", border: "#FD9D24" },
  12: { bg: "#BF8B2E", text: "#fff", border: "#BF8B2E" },
  13: { bg: "#3F7E44", text: "#fff", border: "#3F7E44" },
  14: { bg: "#0A97D9", text: "#fff", border: "#0A97D9" },
  15: { bg: "#56C02B", text: "#fff", border: "#56C02B" },
  16: { bg: "#00689D", text: "#fff", border: "#00689D" },
  17: { bg: "#19486A", text: "#fff", border: "#19486A" },
};

// SDG short labels
const SDG_LABELS: Record<SDG, string> = {
  1:  "No Poverty",
  2:  "Zero Hunger",
  3:  "Good Health",
  4:  "Quality Education",
  5:  "Gender Equality",
  6:  "Clean Water",
  7:  "Clean Energy",
  8:  "Decent Work",
  9:  "Industry & Innovation",
  10: "Reduced Inequalities",
  11: "Sustainable Cities",
  12: "Responsible Consumption",
  13: "Climate Action",
  14: "Life Below Water",
  15: "Life on Land",
  16: "Peace & Justice",
  17: "Partnerships",
};

interface ProjectFiltersProps {
  filters: FilterState;
  /** Only SDGs present in the current project list */
  availableSdgs: SDG[];
  onChange: (filters: FilterState) => void;
}

const DEFAULT_FILTERS: FilterState = {
  category: "all",
  sdgs: [],
  city: "all",
  status: "all",
  startDate: "",
  endDate: "",
};

export function ProjectFilters({ filters, availableSdgs, onChange }: ProjectFiltersProps) {
  const toggleSdg = (sdg: SDG) => {
    const next = filters.sdgs.includes(sdg)
      ? filters.sdgs.filter((s) => s !== sdg)
      : [...filters.sdgs, sdg];
    onChange({ ...filters, sdgs: next });
  };

  const hasFilters = filters.sdgs.length > 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      {/* SDG multi-select */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium uppercase tracking-widest">
          Filter by SDG
        </span>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2" role="group" aria-label="Filter by Sustainable Development Goal">
          {availableSdgs.map((sdg) => {
            const active = filters.sdgs.includes(sdg);
            const colors = SDG_COLORS[sdg];
            return (
              <button
                key={sdg}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => toggleSdg(sdg)}
                aria-pressed={active}
                title={`SDG ${sdg}: ${SDG_LABELS[sdg]}`}
                className={cn(
                  "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border transition-all duration-150 focus-ring",
                  active ? "opacity-100 shadow-sm" : "opacity-60 hover:opacity-90"
                )}
                style={
                  active
                    ? { backgroundColor: colors.bg, color: colors.text, borderColor: colors.border }
                    : { backgroundColor: "transparent", color: colors.bg, borderColor: colors.bg }
                }
              >
                <span
                  className="w-4 h-4 rounded-sm flex items-center justify-center text-[9px] font-bold flex-shrink-0"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: colors.bg, color: colors.text }}
                  aria-hidden="true"
                >
                  {sdg}
                </span>
                {SDG_LABELS[sdg]}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Active filter chips + clear */}
      {hasFilters && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2" aria-label="Active filters">
          {filters.sdgs.map((sdg) => {
            const colors = SDG_COLORS[sdg as SDG];
            return (
              <span
                key={sdg}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full"
                style={{ backgroundColor: colors.bg, color: colors.text }}
              >
                SDG {sdg}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => toggleSdg(sdg as SDG)}
                  aria-label={`Remove SDG ${sdg} filter`}
                  className="hover:opacity-70 transition-opacity focus-ring rounded-full ml-0.5"
                >
                  <X size={10} aria-hidden="true" />
                </button>
              </span>
            );
          })}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onChange(DEFAULT_FILTERS)}
            className="text-xs text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-900 transition-colors focus-ring rounded-md px-1"
          >
            Clear all
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import type { GroupedProject } from "@/lib/projects/grouped-types";
import { ProjectFilters } from "./ProjectFilters";
import { GroupedProjectGrid } from "./GroupedProjectGrid";
import { ProjectCategorySelector } from "./ProjectCategorySelector";
import { filterProjects, type FilterState } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { SDG } from "@/data/projects";

const DEFAULT_FILTERS: FilterState = {
  category: "all",
  sdgs: [],
  city: "all",
  status: "all",
  startDate: "",
  endDate: "",
};

interface ProjectsPageClientProps {
  projects: GroupedProject[];
  locale: string;
}

function normalizeCategory(value: string | null): Exclude<FilterState["category"], "all"> | null {
  if (value === "volunteer" || value === "talent" || value === "teaching") {
    return value;
  }
  return null;
}

export function ProjectsPageClient({ projects, locale }: ProjectsPageClientProps) {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const selectedCategory = normalizeCategory(searchParams.get("category"));
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<FilterState>(DEFAULT_FILTERS);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedCategory) {
      setFilters({
        ...DEFAULT_FILTERS,
        category: selectedCategory,
      });
    } else {
      setFilters(DEFAULT_FILTERS);
    }
  }, [selectedCategory]);

  const availableSdgs = useMemo(
    () =>
      Array.from(
        new Set<number>(projects.flatMap((project) => project.sdgs as number[]))
      ).sort((a, b) => a - b) as SDG[],
    [projects]
  );

  const filtered = useMemo(
    () => filterProjects(projects, filters),
    [projects, filters]
  );

  const resetHref = `/${locale}/our-projects`;

  if (!selectedCategory) {
    return <ProjectCategorySelector projects={projects} locale={locale} />;
  }

  return (
    <section aria-label="Projects listing" className="py-16 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-col gap-8">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="text-accent text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.22em] mb-3">

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";

const CURRENCIES = [
  { code: "TND", label: "Tunisian Dinar" },
  { code: "USD", label: "US Dollar" },
  { code: "EUR", label: "Euro" },
  { code: "GBP", label: "British Pound" },
  { code: "CAD", label: "Canadian Dollar" },
  { code: "AUD", label: "Australian Dollar" },
  { code: "CHF", label: "Swiss Franc" },
  { code: "JPY", label: "Japanese Yen" },
  { code: "CNY", label: "Chinese Yuan" },
  { code: "INR", label: "Indian Rupee" },
  { code: "MAD", label: "Moroccan Dirham" },
  { code: "DZD", label: "Algerian Dinar" },
  { code: "EGP", label: "Egyptian Pound" },
  { code: "SAR", label: "Saudi Riyal" },
  { code: "AED", label: "UAE Dirham" },
  { code: "TRY", label: "Turkish Lira" },
  { code: "BRL", label: "Brazilian Real" },
  { code: "ZAR", label: "South African Rand" },
  { code: "KRW", label: "South Korean Won" },
  { code: "SGD", label: "Singapore Dollar" },
];

export function CurrencyConverter() {
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState("100");
  const [from, setFrom] = useState("EUR");
  const [to, setTo] = useState("TND");
  const [result, setResult] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [source, setSource] = useState<"live" | "static" | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(false);

  const convert = useCallback(async () => {
    const num = parseFloat(amount);
    if (!amount.trim() || isNaN(num) || num < 0) { setResult(null); setLoading(false); return; }
    setLoading(true);
    setError(false);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/currency?from=${from}&to=${to}&amount=${num}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("failed");
      const json = await res.json();
      setResult(json.result);
      setSource(json.source);
    } catch {
      setError(true);
      setResult(null);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [amount, from, to]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(convert, 400);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [convert]);

  const swap = () => { setFrom(to); setTo(from); };

  const fromLabel = CURRENCIES.find((c) => c.code === from)?.label ?? from;
  const toLabel   = CURRENCIES.find((c) => c.code === to)?.label ?? to;

  return (
    <section
      id="currency"
      aria-labelledby="currency-heading"
      className="py-24 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 bg-[var(--section-alt)]"
    >
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto">

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="mb-10">
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-accent mb-3">
            Exchange Rates
          </p>
          <h2
            id="currency-heading"
            className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-3 leading-tight"
          >
            Currency Converter
          </h2>
          <p className="text-gray-500 max-w-lg text-base leading-relaxed">
            Convert between Tunisian Dinar and major world currencies.
            Rates refresh hourly from open.er-api.com.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-sm p-6 sm:p-8">

          {/* Amount input â€” full width, prominent */}
          <div className="mb-5">
            <label htmlFor="currency-amount" className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-400 mb-2">
              Amount
            </label>
            <input
              id="currency-amount"
              type="number"
              min="0"
              step="any"
              value={amount}
              onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-200 px-5 py-4 text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:border-transparent tabular-nums bg-gray-50 transition-colors"
              aria-label="Amount to convert"
              placeholder="0"
            />
          </div>

          {/* From / Swap / To row */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr] items-end gap-3">
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="currency-from" className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-400 mb-2">
                From
              </label>
              <select
                id="currency-from"
                value={from}
                onChange={(e) => setFrom(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-200 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:border-transparent"
              >
                {CURRENCIES.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c.code} value={c.code}>{c.code} â€” {c.label}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Swap â€” centred between the two selects */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={swap}
              aria-label="Swap currencies"
              className="mb-0 w-10 h-10 rounded-full border border-gray-200 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 hover:border-gray-300 active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-500 transition-all duration-150 self-end"
            >
              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
                <path d="M2 5h12M2 5l3-3M2 5l3 3M14 11H2M14 11l-3-3M14 11l-3 3" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"/>
              </svg>
            </button>

            <div>
              <label htmlFor="currency-to" className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-400 mb-2">
                To
              </label>
              <select
                id="currency-to"
                value={to}
                onChange={(e) => setTo(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-200 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:border-transparent"
              >

                  <option key={c.code} value={c.code}>{c.code} â€” {c.label}</option>

            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Result */}
          <div className="mt-5 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 border border-gray-100 px-6 py-5 min-h-[88px] flex items-center justify-between transition-all">

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-400 text-sm">
                <span className="inline-block w-3 h-3 rounded-full border-2 border-gray-300 border-t-accent animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
                Convertingâ€¦
              </div>
            )}
            {error && !loading && (
              <span className="text-red-500 text-sm">Conversion unavailable â€” please try again.</span>
            )}
            {!loading && !error && result === null && (
              <span className="text-gray-400 text-sm">Enter an amount above to see the conversion.</span>
            )}
            {!loading && !error && result !== null && (
              <>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">
                    {amount} {fromLabel} =
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 tabular-nums leading-none">
                    {result.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 4 })}{" "}
                    <span className="text-accent text-xl font-semibold">{to}</span>
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1.5">{toLabel}</p>

                {source && (

                    source === "live"

                      : "bg-amber-50 text-amber-600"
                  }`}>
                    {source === "live" ? "Live rate" : "Estimated"}
                  </span>
                )}
              </>
            )}

export function EstimatorSection() {
  const [values, setValues] = useState<SliderValues>(DEFAULT_VALUES);
  const [openGroups, setOpenGroups] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set(["housing", "food"]));

  const total = Object.values(values).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const totalEur = Math.round(total * TND_TO_EUR);
  const totalUsd = Math.round(total * TND_TO_USD);

  const handleChange = (key: SliderKey, value: number) => {
    setValues((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));

  const toggleGroup = (id: string) => {
    setOpenGroups((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      next.has(id) ? next.delete(id) : next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

    <section
      id="estimator"
      aria-labelledby="estimator-heading"
      className="py-20 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 bg-white"

  );
}

// ── Desktop parallax hero ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function DesktopHero() {
  const skyRef   = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const fgRef    = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const brandRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const mouseTarget  = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const mouseCurrent = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const rafId        = useRef<number>(0);
  const prefersReducedMotion = useRef(false);

  const applyTransform = useCallback(
    (el: HTMLDivElement | null, scrollY: number, mx: number, my: number, cfg: typeof LAYERS[keyof typeof LAYERS]) => {
      if (!el) return;
      const sy = scrollY * cfg.scrollFactor;
      const dx = mx * cfg.mouseFactor;
      const dy = my * cfg.mouseFactor;
      el.style.transform = `translate3d(${dx}px, calc(-50% + ${sy + dy}px), 0)`;
    },
    []
  );

  // Brand: -50% X baked in so left:clamp(...) centers correctly
  const applyBrandTransform = useCallback(
    (el: HTMLDivElement | null, scrollY: number, mx: number, my: number) => {
      if (!el) return;
      const sy = scrollY * LAYERS.brand.scrollFactor;
      const dx = mx * LAYERS.brand.mouseFactor;
      const dy = my * LAYERS.brand.mouseFactor;
      el.style.transform = `translate3d(calc(-50% + ${dx}px), calc(-50% + ${sy + dy}px), 0)`;
    },
    []
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    prefersReducedMotion.current = mq.matches;
    const onMqChange = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => { prefersReducedMotion.current = e.matches; };
    mq.addEventListener("change", onMqChange);

    const isTouchDevice = window.matchMedia("(hover: none)").matches;

    const onMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (isTouchDevice || prefersReducedMotion.current) return;
      mouseTarget.current.x = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth  - 0.5) * 2;
      mouseTarget.current.y = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight - 0.5) * 2;
    };
    const onMouseLeave = () => { mouseTarget.current.x = 0; mouseTarget.current.y = 0; };

    window.addEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener("mouseleave", onMouseLeave);

    const tick = () => {
      const scrollY = window.scrollY;
      if (prefersReducedMotion.current) {
        if (skyRef.current)   skyRef.current.style.transform   = "translate3d(0, -50%, 0)";
        if (fgRef.current)    fgRef.current.style.transform    = "translate3d(0, -50%, 0)";
        if (brandRef.current) brandRef.current.style.transform = "translate3d(-50%, -50%, 0)";
      } else {
        mouseCurrent.current.x += (mouseTarget.current.x - mouseCurrent.current.x) * MOUSE_EASE;
        mouseCurrent.current.y += (mouseTarget.current.y - mouseCurrent.current.y) * MOUSE_EASE;
        const mx = mouseCurrent.current.x;
        const my = mouseCurrent.current.y;
        applyTransform(skyRef.current,   scrollY, mx, my, LAYERS.sky);
        applyTransform(fgRef.current,    scrollY, mx, my, LAYERS.foreground);
        applyBrandTransform(brandRef.current, scrollY, mx, my);
      }
      rafId.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    rafId.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(rafId.current);
      window.removeEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener("mouseleave", onMouseLeave);
      mq.removeEventListener("change", onMqChange);
    };
  }, [applyTransform, applyBrandTransform]);

  return (
    <section
      aria-label="Hero — AIESEC in Bardo"
      className="relative w-full overflow-hidden"
      style={{ height: "100svh" }}
    >
      {/* 1. Base gradient */}
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="absolute inset-0 z-0"
        style={{ background: "linear-gradient(180deg, #1a0a00 0%, #3d1a00 25%, #7a3510 55%, #c4621a 80%, #e8892a 100%)" }}
      />

      {/* 2. Sky */}
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="absolute inset-x-0 z-10 pointer-events-none"
        style={{ top: "50%", transform: "translate3d(0, -50%, 0)", willChange: "transform" }}
        ref={skyRef}
      >
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img
          src="/hero/Sky Backgound.png"
          alt=""
          className="w-full h-auto block"
          style={{ filter: "blur(0.5px) brightness(0.92) saturate(1.15)", minHeight: "100svh", objectFit: "cover" }}
          draggable={false}
        />
      </div>

      {/* 3. Atmospheric haze */}
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="absolute inset-0 z-20 pointer-events-none"
        style={{ background: "linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(20,6,0,0.55) 0%, rgba(60,20,0,0.18) 35%, rgba(180,80,10,0.10) 65%, rgba(220,110,20,0.30) 100%)" }}
      />

      {/* 4. Branding — behind aqueduct */}
      <style>{`.hero-brand { left: clamp(5%, calc(44% - 20vw), 45%); width: min(480px, 72vw); }`}</style>
      <div
        className="hero-brand absolute z-[25] pointer-events-none"
        style={{
          top: "clamp(30svh, calc(50svh - 20svh * (1280px - 100vw) / 905px), 50svh)",
          transform: "translate3d(-50%, -50%, 0)",
          willChange: "transform",
        }}
        ref={brandRef}
      >
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img
          src="/hero/Live it with Bardo.png"
          alt="Live it with AIESEC in Bardo"
          className="w-full h-auto block"
          style={{ filter: "drop-shadow(0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.50))" }}
          draggable={false}
        />
      </div>

      {/* 5. Foreground / aqueduct */}
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="absolute inset-x-0 z-30 pointer-events-none"
        style={{ top: "50%", transform: "translate3d(0, -50%, 0)", willChange: "transform" }}
        ref={fgRef}
      >
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img
          src="/hero/Foreground.png"
          alt=""
          className="w-full h-auto block"
          style={{ minHeight: "100svh", objectFit: "cover", objectPosition: "center bottom" }}
          draggable={false}
        />
      </div>

      {/* 6. Vignette */}
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="absolute inset-0 z-40 pointer-events-none"
        style={{ background: "radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 50% 50%, transparent 30%, rgba(10,3,0,0.55) 100%)" }}
      />

      {/* 7. Bottom fade */}
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 pointer-events-none"
        style={{ height: "8%", background: "linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.25) 100%)" }}
      />
    </section>
  );
}

// ── Exported component — switches based on viewport ──────────────────────────
export function HeroSection() {
  // null = not yet measured (SSR), true = mobile, false = desktop
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState<boolean | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 768px)");
    setIsMobile(mq.matches);
    const handler = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setIsMobile(e.matches);
    mq.addEventListener("change", handler);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener("change", handler);
  }, []);

  // During SSR / before hydration: render a placeholder to avoid layout shift
  if (isMobile === null) return <div style={{ height: "100svh" }} aria-hidden="true" />;

  return isMobile ? <MobileHero /> : <DesktopHero />;
}

"use client";

import { useScroll, useTransform, motion, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";
import { useState } from "react";
import { AiesecHuman } from "@/components/ui/AiesecHuman";
import type {
  HeroLayoutConfig,
  AnyLayer,
  LayerProps,
  TextLayerProps,
  BadgeGroupConfig,
} from "@/lib/hero-layout-types";
import { isImageLayer, isBadgeGroup, isTextOverlay } from "@/lib/hero-layout-types";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function useLayerY(yFactor: number) {
  const { scrollY } = useScroll();
  return useTransform(scrollY, [0, 800], [0, yFactor * 120]);
}

function SafeImg({
  src,
  alt,
  style,
  className,
}: {
  src: string;
  alt: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const [err, setErr] = useState(false);
  if (err) {
    return (
      <div
        className={className}
        style={{ ...style, background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.05)", borderRadius: 8 }}
        aria-hidden="true"
      />
    );
  }
  // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
  return (
    <img
      src={src}
      alt={alt}
      style={style}
      className={className}
      onError={() => setErr(true)}
    />
  );
}

function layerStyle(props: LayerProps, isBg = false): React.CSSProperties {
  if (isBg) {
    return {
      position: "absolute",
      inset: 0,
      width: "100%",
      height: "100%",
      opacity: props.opacity,
      zIndex: props.zIndex,
    };
  }
  return {
    position: "absolute",
    left: `${props.x}%`,
    top: `${props.y}%`,
    width: `${props.width}%`,
    transform: `translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(${props.rotation}deg)`,
    opacity: props.opacity,
    zIndex: props.zIndex,
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Layer renderers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function BadgeGroupLayer({
  layer,
  props,
  reducedMotion,
}: {
  layer: BadgeGroupConfig;
  props: LayerProps;
  reducedMotion: boolean;
}) {
  const y = useLayerY(reducedMotion ? 0 : layer.parallax.yFactor);
  const { badges, arrangement } = layer;
  const { radius, startAngleDeg, centerBadgeIndex } = arrangement;
  const ringBadges = badges.filter((_b, i) => i !== centerBadgeIndex);
  const angleStep = ringBadges.length > 0 ? 360 / ringBadges.length : 0;

  return (
    <motion.div style={{ y, ...layerStyle(props) }} aria-hidden="true">
      <div className="relative w-full" style={{ paddingBottom: "100%" }}>
        {badges[centerBadgeIndex] && (
          <div
            style={{
              position: "absolute",
              left: "50%",
              top: "50%",
              transform: "translate(-50%,-50%)",
              width: "12%",
              height: "12%",
            }}
          >
            <SafeImg
              src={badges[centerBadgeIndex].src}
              alt={badges[centerBadgeIndex].alt}
              className="w-full h-full object-contain"
            />
          </div>
        )}
        {ringBadges.map((badge, i) => {
          const angleDeg = startAngleDeg + i * angleStep;
          const angleRad = (angleDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
          const cx = 50 + radius * Math.cos(angleRad);
          const cy = 50 + radius * Math.sin(angleRad);
          const isLast = i === ringBadges.length - 1;
          return (
            <div
              key={badge.src}
              className={isLast ? "hidden sm:block" : "block"}
              style={{
                position: "absolute",
                left: `${cx}%`,
                top: `${cy}%`,
                transform: "translate(-50%,-50%)",
                width: "9%",
                height: "9%",
              }}
            >
              <SafeImg src={badge.src} alt={badge.alt} className="w-full h-full object-contain" />
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

function LayerRenderer({
  layer,
  mode,
  reducedMotion,
}: {
  layer: AnyLayer;
  mode: "desktop" | "mobile";
  reducedMotion: boolean;
}) {
  const props = layer[mode] as LayerProps;
  const y = useLayerY(reducedMotion ? 0 : layer.parallax.yFactor);
  if (!props.visible) return null;

  if (isImageLayer(layer)) {
    const isBg = layer.type === "background";
    return (
      <motion.div style={{ y: isBg ? 0 : y, ...layerStyle(props, isBg) }} aria-hidden="true">
        <SafeImg src={layer.assetPath} alt="" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
      </motion.div>
    );
  }

  if (isBadgeGroup(layer)) {
    return <BadgeGroupLayer layer={layer} props={props} reducedMotion={reducedMotion} />;
  }

  if (isTextOverlay(layer)) {
    const textProps = props as TextLayerProps;
    return (
      <motion.div style={{ y, ...layerStyle(props), pointerEvents: "none" }}>
        <div
          className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4 px-8 py-6 rounded-3xl bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-sm border border-gray-100 text-center"
          style={{ maxWidth: textProps.maxWidth, textAlign: textProps.textAlign }}
        >
          <AiesecHuman size={56} />
          <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold text-gray-900 leading-tight">
            Behind each exchange a <span className="text-accent">STORY</span>
          </h1>
          {textProps.showSubtitle && (
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
              Discover Tunisia through the eyes of those who lived it.
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    );
  }

  return null;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Public component
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

interface HeroSectionPreviewProps {
  config: HeroLayoutConfig;
  mode?: "desktop" | "mobile";
}

export function HeroSectionPreview({ config, mode = "desktop" }: HeroSectionPreviewProps) {
  const reducedMotion = useReducedMotion() ?? false;
  const sorted = [...config.layers].sort(
    (a, b) => (a[mode] as LayerProps).zIndex - (b[mode] as LayerProps).zIndex
  );

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full min-h-full overflow-hidden bg-white">
      {sorted.map((layer) => (
        <LayerRenderer key={layer.id} layer={layer} mode={mode} reducedMotion={reducedMotion} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";

/**
 * AIESEC Human mark component.
 *
 * Source asset: aiesec-human-blue.ai (not used in runtime â€” design reference only)
 *
 * Fallback chain:
 *   1. /logos/aiesec-human-blue.svg  (primary â€” vector, crisp at any size)
 *   2. /logos/aiesec-human-blue.png  (raster fallback)
 *   3. Inline SVG reproduction       (always available, no file dependency)
 */

interface AiesecHumanProps {
  size?: number;
  className?: string;
}

/** Stage 3: inline SVG â€” always available, no file dependency */
function AiesecHumanInline({ size, className }: { size: number; className: string }) {
  return (
    <svg
      width={size}
      height={size}
      viewBox="0 0 100 100"
      fill="none"

      className={className}
    >
      <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="50" fill="var(--accent)" />
      <circle cx="50" cy="32" r="14" fill="white" />
      <path d="M18 88 C18 66 32 56 50 56 C68 56 82 66 82 88" fill="white" />
    </svg>
  );
}

/** Stage 2: PNG raster fallback */
function AiesecHumanPng({
  size,
  className,
  onError,
}: {
  size: number;
  className: string;
  onError: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
    <img
      src="/logos/aiesec-human-blue.png"
      alt=""
      aria-hidden="true"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      className={className}
      onError={onError}
      style={{ display: "block" }}
    />
  );
}

export function AiesecHuman({ size = 48, className = "" }: AiesecHumanProps) {
  const [svgError, setSvgError] = useState(false);
  const [pngError, setPngError] = useState(false);

  // Stage 3: inline SVG
  if (svgError && pngError) {
    return <AiesecHumanInline size={size} className={className} />;
  }

  // Stage 2: PNG
  if (svgError) {
    return (
      <AiesecHumanPng
        size={size}
        className={className}
        onError={() => setPngError(true)}
      />
    );
  }

  // Stage 1: SVG (primary)
  return (
    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
    <img
      src="/logos/aiesec-human-blue.svg"
      alt=""
      aria-hidden="true"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      className={className}
      onError={() => setSvgError(true)}
      style={{ display: "block" }}
    />
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";

export interface MediaItem {
  type: "image" | "video";
  src: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  alt?: string;
}

interface MediaCarouselProps {
  items: MediaItem[];
  aspectRatio?: string;
}

const PLACEHOLDER = "/hero/hero_static_default.png";

export function MediaCarousel({ items, aspectRatio = "aspect-[4/3]" }: MediaCarouselProps) {
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(0);
  const videoRefs = useRef<(HTMLVideoElement | null)[]>([]);
  const total = items.length;

  const goTo = useCallback(
    (idx: number) => {
      const resolved = ((idx % total) + total) % total;
      const vid = videoRefs.current[current];
      if (vid) vid.pause();
      setCurrent(resolved);
    },
    [current, total]
  );

  const goPrev = useCallback(() => goTo(current - 1), [current, goTo]);
  const goNext = useCallback(() => goTo(current + 1), [current, goTo]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const vid = videoRefs.current[current];
    if (vid) { vid.currentTime = 0; vid.play().catch(() => {}); }
  }, [current]);

  const touchStartX = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const onTouchStart = (e: React.TouchEvent) => { touchStartX.current = e.touches[0].clientX; };
  const onTouchEnd = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    if (touchStartX.current === null) return;
    const delta = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - touchStartX.current;
    if (Math.abs(delta) > 40) delta < 0 ? goNext() : goPrev();
    touchStartX.current = null;
  };

  if (total === 0) return null;

  const prevIdx = ((current - 1) % total + total) % total;
  const nextIdx = (current + 1) % total;

  const getPos = (i: number): "prev" | "active" | "next" | "hidden" => {
    if (i === current) return "active";
    if (i === prevIdx) return "prev";
    if (i === nextIdx) return "next";
    return "hidden";
  };

  const posClass: Record<string, string> = {
    active: "translate-x-0 scale-100 z-20 opacity-100",
    prev:   "-translate-x-[64%] scale-[0.80] z-10 opacity-50",
    next:   "translate-x-[64%] scale-[0.80] z-10 opacity-50",
    hidden: "translate-x-0 scale-75 z-0 opacity-0 pointer-events-none",
  };

  const activeItem = items[current];

  return (
    <div
      className="relative w-full select-none"
      role="region"
      aria-label="Media carousel"
      onTouchStart={onTouchStart}
      onTouchEnd={onTouchEnd}
    >
      {/* Track */}
      <div className="relative overflow-hidden px-[14%]">
        <div className={`relative w-full ${aspectRatio}`}>
          {items.map((item, i) => {
            const pos = getPos(i);
            const src = item.src && item.src.trim() !== "" ? item.src : PLACEHOLDER;

            return (
              <div
                key={`${item.src}-${i}`}
                aria-hidden={pos !== "active"}
                onClick={() => pos !== "active" && goTo(i)}
                className={`absolute inset-0 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden bg-gray-100 transition-all duration-500 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)] ${pos !== "active" ? "cursor-pointer" : ""} ${posClass[pos]}`}
              >
                {item.type === "video" ? (
                  <video
                    ref={(el) => { videoRefs.current[i] = el; }}
                    src={src}
                    autoPlay={pos === "active"}
                    muted loop playsInline
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                  />
                ) : (
                  <Image
                    src={src}
                    alt={item.alt ?? item.title}
                    fill
                    className="object-cover"
                    sizes="(max-width: 768px) 90vw, 60vw"
                    priority={i === 0}
                  />
                )}

                {/* Active card: bottom gradient for text legibility */}
                {pos === "active" && (
                  <div
                    className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-2/5 pointer-events-none"
                    style={{ background: "linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.55) 0%, transparent 100%)" }}
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  />
                )}

                {/* Active card: title overlay */}
                {pos === "active" && (
                  <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 px-5 pb-5 pointer-events-none">
                    <p className="text-white font-semibold text-base leading-snug drop-shadow-sm">
                      {item.title}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Side cards: dim overlay */}
                {pos !== "active" && (
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/30 rounded-3xl" />
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Nav arrows â€” positioned at card mid-height, outside the track */}
      <button
        onClick={goPrev}
        aria-label="Previous slide"
        className="absolute left-1 top-[40%] -translate-y-1/2 z-30 w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white/95 shadow-lg hover:bg-white hover:shadow-xl active:scale-95 text-gray-700 flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-150"
      >
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M9 2L4 7l5 5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"/>
        </svg>
      </button>
      <button
        onClick={goNext}
        aria-label="Next slide"
        className="absolute right-1 top-[40%] -translate-y-1/2 z-30 w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white/95 shadow-lg hover:bg-white hover:shadow-xl active:scale-95 text-gray-700 flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-150"
      >
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M5 2l5 5-5 5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"/>
        </svg>
      </button>

      {/* Description below card */}
      <div className="mt-5 px-2">
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 leading-relaxed text-center max-w-lg mx-auto min-h-[3rem]">
          {activeItem.description}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Dots */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 mt-4" role="tablist" aria-label="Slides">
        {items.map((_, i) => (
          <button
            key={i}
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={i === current}
            aria-label={`Go to slide ${i + 1}`}
            onClick={() => goTo(i)}
            className={`rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
              i === current ? "w-5 h-1.5 bg-accent" : "w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-400"
            }`}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";
import { useCounter } from "@/lib/hooks/useCounter";
import type { Stat } from "@/data/stats";

interface StatCounterProps {
  stat: Stat;
  shouldAnimate: boolean;
}

export function StatCounter({ stat, shouldAnimate }: StatCounterProps) {
  const prefersReducedMotion = useReducedMotion();
  const active = shouldAnimate && !prefersReducedMotion;
  const animatedCount = useCounter(stat.value, 2000, active);
  const displayValue = prefersReducedMotion && shouldAnimate ? stat.value : animatedCount;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center px-6 py-8">
      <span className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold text-gray-900 tabular-nums leading-none">
        {displayValue}
        <span className="text-accent">{stat.suffix}</span>
      </span>
      <span className="mt-3 text-xs text-gray-400 font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest">
        {stat.label}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

Write-Section "Writing CSV export API route"
$routeContent = @'
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { loadRawOpportunities } from "@/lib/projects/loader";
import { transformGisOpportunity } from "@/lib/projects/transform";

function csvEscape(value: unknown): string {
  const str = value == null ? "" : String(value);
  return `"${str.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
}

export async function GET() {
  if (process.env.APP_ENV === "production" || process.env.APP_ENV === undefined) {
    return new NextResponse(null, { status: 404 });
  }

  const raw = await loadRawOpportunities();
  const transformed = raw.map(transformGisOpportunity);
  const active = transformed.filter((project) => project.isOpen);

  const headers = [
    "id",
    "slug",
    "title",
    "programme",
    "isOpen",
    "startDate",
    "endDate",
    "city",
    "category",
    "sdgs",
    "description",
  ];

  const lines = [
    headers.join(","),
    ...active.map((project) =>
      [
        csvEscape(project.id),
        csvEscape(project.slug),
        csvEscape(project.title),
        csvEscape(project.programme ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.isOpen ? "open" : "closed"),
        csvEscape(project.startDate ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.endDate ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.city ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.category ?? ""),
        csvEscape(Array.isArray(project.sdgs) ? project.sdgs.join("|") : ""),
        csvEscape(project.description ?? ""),
      ].join(",")
    ),
  ];

  return new NextResponse(lines.join("\n"), {
    status: 200,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8",
      "Cache-Control": "no-store",
      "Content-Disposition": 'attachment; filename="active-projects.csv"',
    },
  });
}

/**
 * Locale-aware data loader.
 * Returns the appropriate data for the given locale,
 * falling back to English when a translation is not available.
 */

import type { Locale } from "@/i18n/config";
import { faqEntries, FALLBACK_MESSAGE } from "@/data/faq";
import type { FaqEntry } from "@/data/faq";

export async function getFaqEntries(locale: Locale): Promise<FaqEntry[]> {
  if (locale === "fr") {
    const { faqEntriesFr } = await import("./fr/faq");
    return faqEntriesFr;
  }
  if (locale === "ar") {
    const { faqEntriesAr } = await import("./ar/faq");
    return faqEntriesAr;
  }
  return faqEntries;
}

export { FALLBACK_MESSAGE };

/**
 * Locale-aware data loading types.
 *
 * Architecture:
 * - data/*.ts = English canonical source (existing files, unchanged)
 * - data/i18n/[locale]/*.ts = translated content for fr/ar
 * - data/i18n/loader.ts = unified loader that returns locale-appropriate data
 *
 * Structural fields (sdgs, dates, city, category, isOpen, slug, coordinates)
 * are locale-independent and always come from the canonical English source.
 * Only human-readable text fields (title, description, question, answer, etc.)
 * are translated.
 */

import type { Locale } from "@/i18n/config";

export type { Locale };

Write-Section "Patching CSV export route to derive programme from raw GIS rows"
$routeContent = @'
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { loadRawOpportunities } from "@/lib/projects/loader";
import { transformGisOpportunity } from "@/lib/projects/transform";

function csvEscape(value: unknown): string {
  const str = value == null ? "" : String(value);
  return `"${str.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
}

export async function GET() {
  if (process.env.APP_ENV === "production" || process.env.APP_ENV === undefined) {
    return new NextResponse(null, { status: 404 });
  }

  const raw = await loadRawOpportunities();
  const transformed = raw.map(transformGisOpportunity);
  const active = transformed.filter((project) => project.isOpen);

  const programmeById = new Map(
    raw.map((opp) => [String(opp.id), opp.programme?.short_name ?? ""])
  );

  const headers = [
    "id",
    "slug",
    "title",
    "programme",
    "isOpen",
    "startDate",
    "endDate",
    "city",
    "category",
    "sdgs",
    "description",
  ];

  const lines = [
    headers.join(","),
    ...active.map((project) =>
      [
        csvEscape(project.id),
        csvEscape(project.slug),
        csvEscape(project.title),
        csvEscape(programmeById.get(String(project.id)) ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.isOpen ? "open" : "closed"),
        csvEscape(project.startDate ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.endDate ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.city ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.category ?? ""),
        csvEscape(Array.isArray(project.sdgs) ? project.sdgs.join("|") : ""),
        csvEscape(project.description ?? ""),
      ].join(",")
    ),
  ];

  return new NextResponse(lines.join("\n"), {
    status: 200,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8",
      "Cache-Control": "no-store",
      "Content-Disposition": 'attachment; filename="active-projects.csv"',
    },
  });
}

function Write-TextFile($path, $content) {
  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $path
  if ($dir -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null
  }
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $content, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
  Write-Host "[written] $path" -ForegroundColor Green
}

import type { ProjectCategory } from "@/data/projects";
import type { GroupedProject, ProjectSlot } from "./grouped-types";
import type { GisOpportunity } from "./gis-types";

/**
 * Transforms raw GIS opportunities into GroupedProject objects.
 * One GIS opportunity = one GroupedProject (slots are nested, not separate rows).
 */

function slugify(value: string) {
  return value
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/&/g, "and")
    .replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g, "")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/(^-|-$)+/g, "");
}

function stripBracketSuffix(value: string) {
  return value.replace(/\s*\[[^\]]*\]\s*/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

export function hasSlots(opp: GisOpportunity): boolean {
  return Array.isArray(opp.all_slots?.nodes) && opp.all_slots!.nodes.length > 0;
}

function mapCategory(opp: GisOpportunity): ProjectCategory {
  const id = opp.programme?.id;

  if (id === "7") return "volunteer"; // GV
  if (id === "8") return "talent";    // GTa
  if (id === "9") return "teaching";  // GTe

  return "volunteer";
}

function getProgrammeDisplay(
  programme: { id: string; short_name: string | null } | null | undefined
) {
  const p = programme as
    | ({ id: string; short_name: string | null; short_name_display?: string | null })
    | null
    | undefined;

  return p?.short_name_display ?? p?.short_name ?? "";
}

function buildDescription(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  const base = (opp.description ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  const logistics = [];
  if (opp.logistics_info?.accommodation_covered === "covered") logistics.push("accommodation");
  if (opp.logistics_info?.food_covered === "covered") logistics.push("meals");
  if (opp.logistics_info?.transportation_covered === "covered") logistics.push("transportation");

  const extras = [];
  if (logistics.length > 0) extras.push(`Includes: ${logistics.join(", ")}.`);

  const fee = getProjectFee(opp);
  if (fee.amount != null && fee.currency) {
    extras.push(`Project fee: ${fee.amount} ${fee.currency}.`);
  }

  return [base, ...extras].filter(Boolean).join(" ").trim();
}

function toProjectSlot(opp: GisOpportunity): ProjectSlot[] {
  const nodes = opp.all_slots?.nodes ?? [];
  return nodes.map((slot) => ({
    startDate: slot.start_date ?? null,
    endDate: slot.end_date ?? null,
    openings: slot.openings ?? null,
    available: slot.openings ?? null,
  }));
}

function sortDateAsc(a: string | null, b: string | null) {
  if (!a && !b) return 0;
  if (!a) return 1;
  if (!b) return -1;
  return a.localeCompare(b);
}

function sortDateDesc(a: string | null, b: string | null) {
  return sortDateAsc(b, a);
}

function getEarliestStart(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  const slotDates = (opp.all_slots?.nodes ?? [])
    .map((slot) => slot.start_date ?? null)
    .filter((v): v is string => Boolean(v))
    .sort(sortDateAsc);

  return slotDates[0] ?? opp.earliest_start_date ?? "";
}

function getLatestEnd(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  const slotDates = (opp.all_slots?.nodes ?? [])
    .map((slot) => slot.end_date ?? null)
    .filter((v): v is string => Boolean(v))
    .sort(sortDateDesc);

  return slotDates[0] ?? opp.latest_end_date ?? "";
}

function getTotalOpenings(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  const nodes = opp.all_slots?.nodes ?? [];
  if (nodes.length === 0) return opp.openings ?? null;

  const sum = nodes.reduce((acc, slot) => acc + (slot.openings ?? 0), 0);
  return sum > 0 ? sum : opp.openings ?? null;
}

function getTotalAvailable(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  if (opp.available_openings != null) return opp.available_openings;

  const nodes = opp.all_slots?.nodes ?? [];
  if (nodes.length === 0) return null;

  const sum = nodes.reduce((acc, slot) => acc + (slot.openings ?? 0), 0);
  return sum > 0 ? sum : null;
}

function getAvailableSlots(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  const nodes = opp.all_slots?.nodes ?? [];
  return nodes.reduce((acc, slot) => acc + ((slot.openings ?? 0) > 0 ? 1 : 0), 0);
}

function getProjectFee(opp: GisOpportunity): GroupedProject["fee"] {
  const fee = opp.fee_and_health_insurance;
  if (!fee || fee.currency !== "EUR") {
    return { amount: null, currency: null };
  }

  if (fee.project_fee != null) {
    return { amount: fee.project_fee, currency: "EUR" };
  }

  if (fee.programme_fee != null) {
    return { amount: fee.programme_fee, currency: "EUR" };
  }

  return { amount: null, currency: null };
}

function getLogistics(opp: GisOpportunity): GroupedProject["logistics"] {
  return {
    accommodation: opp.logistics_info?.accommodation_covered === "covered",
    food: opp.logistics_info?.food_covered === "covered",
    transport: opp.logistics_info?.transportation_covered === "covered",
  };
}

function getExternalApplyUrl(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  return opp.programme?.id === "7"
    ? `https://aiesec.org/opportunity/global-volunteer/${opp.id}`
    : null;
}

export function transformToGroupedProject(
  opp: GisOpportunity,
  fallbackSlug?: string
): GroupedProject {
  const title = stripBracketSuffix(opp.title ?? "Untitled opportunity");
  const programme = getProgrammeDisplay(opp.programme);
  const sdg = opp.sdg_info?.sdg_target?.goal_index;
  const sdgs = typeof sdg === "number" ? [sdg] : [];
  const cleanSlugBase = fallbackSlug || slugify(`${opp.id}-${title || "opportunity"}`);

  return {
    id: `opp-${opp.id}`,
    oppId: String(opp.id),
    slug: cleanSlugBase,
    title,
    description: buildDescription(opp),
    image: opp.cover_photo?.url ?? "/hero/hero_static_default.png",
    alt: opp.cover_photo?.filename ?? "",
    sdgs,
    startDate: getEarliestStart(opp),
    endDate: getLatestEnd(opp),
    city: opp.host_lc?.name ?? "",
    category: mapCategory(opp),
    isOpen: opp.status === "open" && (opp.available_openings ?? 0) > 0,
    programme,
    totalOpenings: getTotalOpenings(opp),
    totalAvailable: getTotalAvailable(opp),
    availableSlots: getAvailableSlots(opp),
    slots: toProjectSlot(opp),
    fee: getProjectFee(opp),
    logistics: getLogistics(opp),
    externalApplyUrl: getExternalApplyUrl(opp),
  };
}

export function transformAllToGroupedProjects(opps: GisOpportunity[]): GroupedProject[] {
  return opps
    .filter(hasSlots)
    .map((opp) => transformToGroupedProject(opp, slugify(`${opp.id}-${stripBracketSuffix(opp.title ?? "opportunity")}`)));
}

function Test-CommandExists($name) {
  return $null -ne (Get-Command $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
}

function Get-ListeningConnectionByPort([int]$TargetPort) {
  try {
    return Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $TargetPort -State Listen -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1
  } catch {
    return $null
  }
}

function Get-ProcessSummaryById([int]$Pid) {
  try {
    return Get-Process -Id $Pid -ErrorAction Stop
  } catch {
    return $null
  }
}

function Get-NextFreePort([int]$StartPort) {
  for ($p = $StartPort; $p -le ($StartPort + 50); $p++) {
    $conn = Get-ListeningConnectionByPort -TargetPort $p
    if (-not $conn) {
      return $p
    }
  }
  throw "No free port found between $StartPort and $($StartPort + 50)."
}

function Stop-ProcessOnPort([int]$TargetPort) {
  $conn = Get-ListeningConnectionByPort -TargetPort $TargetPort
  if (-not $conn) {
    Write-Host "[INFO] No process is listening on port $TargetPort." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    return $false
  }

  $proc = Get-ProcessSummaryById -Pid $conn.OwningProcess
  if ($proc) {
    Write-Host "[INFO] Stopping process on port $TargetPort : $($proc.ProcessName) (PID $($proc.Id))" -ForegroundColor Yellow
  } else {
    Write-Host "[INFO] Stopping unknown process PID $($conn.OwningProcess) on port $TargetPort" -ForegroundColor Yellow
  }

  Stop-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction Stop
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
  return $true
}

function Invoke-Step($label, [scriptblock]$action) {
  Write-Host "[STEP] $label" -ForegroundColor Magenta
  & $action
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "$label failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE."
  }
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import type { GroupedProject } from "@/lib/projects/grouped-types";
import { ProjectFilters } from "./ProjectFilters";

import { ProjectCategorySelector } from "./ProjectCategorySelector";
import { filterProjects, type FilterState } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { SDG } from "@/data/projects";

const DEFAULT_FILTERS: FilterState = {
  category: "all",
  sdgs: [],
  city: "all",
  status: "all",
  startDate: "",
  endDate: "",
};

interface ProjectsPageClientProps {
  projects: GroupedProject[];
  locale: string;
}

function mapCategoryToProgrammes(category: string | null): string[] | null {
  if (category === "volunteer") return ["GV"];
  if (category === "internship") return ["GT", "GTA"];
  if (category === "cultural") return ["GE", "GTE"];
  return null;
}

export function ProjectsPageClient({ projects, locale }: ProjectsPageClientProps) {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const selectedCategory = searchParams.get("category");
  const selectedProgrammes = mapCategoryToProgrammes(selectedCategory);

  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<FilterState>(DEFAULT_FILTERS);

  useEffect(() => {
    setFilters(DEFAULT_FILTERS);
  }, [selectedCategory]);

  const availableSdgs = useMemo(
    () =>
      Array.from(
        new Set<number>(projects.flatMap((project) => project.sdgs as number[]))
      ).sort((a, b) => a - b) as SDG[],
    [projects]
  );

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const base = filterProjects(projects, filters);

    if (!selectedProgrammes) {
      return base;
    }

    return base.filter((project) =>
      selectedProgrammes.includes(project.programme)
    );
  }, [projects, filters, selectedProgrammes]);

  const resetHref = `/${locale}/our-projects`;

  if (!selectedCategory) {
    return <ProjectCategorySelector projects={projects} locale={locale} />;
  }

  return (
    <section className="py-16 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-col gap-8">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:justify-between">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold capitalize">
              {selectedCategory} projects
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-500">
              Filtered by the matching AIESEC programme codes for this category.
            </p>
          </div>

          <a
            href={resetHref}
            className="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-black transition-colors"
          >
            Back
          </a>
        </div>

        <ProjectFilters
          filters={filters}
          availableSdgs={availableSdgs}
          onChange={setFilters}
        />

        <GroupedProjectGrid
          projects={filtered}
          locale={locale}
          onReset={() => setFilters(DEFAULT_FILTERS)}
        />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function Test-IsExcludedPath {
    param(
        [string]$FullPath,
        [string[]]$ExcludedDirNames
    )

    $segments = $FullPath -split '[\\/]'
    foreach ($dir in $ExcludedDirNames) {
        if ($segments -contains $dir) {
            return $true
        }
    }

    return $false
}

import { getRequestConfig } from "next-intl/server";
import { locales, defaultLocale, type Locale } from "./config";

export default getRequestConfig(async ({ requestLocale }) => {
  let locale = await requestLocale;

  // Validate â€” fall back to default if locale is not supported
  if (!locale || !locales.includes(locale as Locale)) {
    locale = defaultLocale;
  }

  return {
    locale,
    messages: (await import(`../messages/${locale}.json`)).default,
  };
});

function Ensure-FileContains($path) {
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path)) {
    throw "Required file not found: $path"
  }
}

function Write-TextFile($path, $content) {
  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $path
  if ($dir -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null
  }
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $content, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
  Write-Host "[written] $path" -ForegroundColor Green
}

/**
 * Centralized environment configuration helper.
 *
 * Rules:
 * - Server-side vars (no NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix): only accessible in Server
 *   Components, API routes, and middleware. Never sent to the browser.
 * - Client-safe vars (NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix): embedded at build time.
 *   Only put values here that are safe to expose publicly.
 *
 * Credentials (STAGING_LOGIN_USERNAME, STAGING_LOGIN_PASSWORD, SESSION_SECRET)
 * are intentionally NOT exported from this file. They are read directly from
 * process.env inside server-only files (app/api/auth/login/route.ts,
 * lib/session.ts, middleware.ts) so they can never leak into a client bundle
 * even if a client component mistakenly imports from lib/env.ts.
 */

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Server-side flags
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** True when APP_ENV is explicitly "production" or unset (safe default). */
export const isProduction =
  process.env.APP_ENV === "production" || process.env.APP_ENV === undefined;

/** True when APP_ENV is explicitly "staging". */
export const isStaging = process.env.APP_ENV === "staging";

/**
 * Whether /admin/* routes and /api/admin/* endpoints are enabled.
 * Defaults to false â€” must be explicitly set to "true".
 */
export const isAdminEnabled = process.env.ENABLE_ADMIN === "true";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Client-safe flags (NEXT_PUBLIC_ â€” embedded at build time)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** Canonical app URL â€” used for metadataBase and absolute URLs. */
export const appUrl =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ?? "https://liveitwithbardo.vercel.app";

/** Whether to render the PromoBar countdown banner. Defaults to true. */
export const showPromoBar = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SHOW_PROMO_BAR !== "false";

/**
 * Whether the navbar should show only production-visible links.
 * Decoupled from isProduction so staging can mirror the production nav
 * without affecting middleware route-guarding (which still uses APP_ENV).
 * Defaults to true (safe â€” shows filtered nav if flag is unset).
 */
export const showProductionNav = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PRODUCTION_NAV !== "false";

/** ISO date string for the PromoBar countdown target. */
export const promoTargetDate =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PROMO_TARGET_DATE ?? "2026-05-15T09:00:00Z";

/** Whether the ChatAgent widget is rendered. Defaults to true. */
export const showChatAgent = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SHOW_CHAT_AGENT !== "false";

/**
 * Type definitions for the Hero layout editor.
 * Used by HeroSectionPreview and the admin hero editor.
 */

export interface LayerProps {
  visible: boolean;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  rotation: number;
  opacity: number;
  zIndex: number;
}

export interface TextLayerProps extends LayerProps {
  maxWidth: number;
  textAlign: "left" | "center" | "right";
  showSubtitle: boolean;
}

export interface ParallaxConfig {
  yFactor: number;
}

export interface BadgeConfig {
  src: string;
  alt: string;
}

export interface BadgeArrangement {
  radius: number;
  startAngleDeg: number;
  centerBadgeIndex: number;
}

export interface BaseLayer {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  parallax: ParallaxConfig;
  desktop: LayerProps;
  mobile: LayerProps;
}

export interface ImageLayer extends BaseLayer {
  type: "image" | "background";
  assetPath: string;
}

export interface BadgeGroupConfig extends BaseLayer {
  type: "badge-group";
  badges: BadgeConfig[];
  arrangement: BadgeArrangement;
}

export interface TextOverlayLayer extends BaseLayer {
  type: "text-overlay";
  desktop: TextLayerProps;
  mobile: TextLayerProps;
}

export type AnyLayer = ImageLayer | BadgeGroupConfig | TextOverlayLayer;

export interface HeroLayoutConfig {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  layers: AnyLayer[];
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Type guards
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function isImageLayer(layer: AnyLayer): layer is ImageLayer {
  return layer.type === "image" || layer.type === "background";
}

export function isBadgeGroup(layer: AnyLayer): layer is BadgeGroupConfig {
  return layer.type === "badge-group";
}

export function isTextOverlay(layer: AnyLayer): layer is TextOverlayLayer {
  return layer.type === "text-overlay";

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

function easeOut(t: number): number {
  return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
}

/**
 * Animates a counter from 0 to `target` over `duration` ms.
 * Only starts when `active` is true.
 *
 * Initializes to 0 on both server and client to avoid hydration mismatches.
 * When not animating (active=false), snaps to target after mount.
 */
export function useCounter(
  target: number,
  duration: number,
  active: boolean
): number {
  // Always start at 0 â€” consistent between SSR and client hydration.
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) {
      // Not animating â€” show the final value immediately after mount.
      setCount(target);
      return;
    }

    let rafId: number;
    const start = performance.now();

    const tick = (now: number) => {
      const elapsed = now - start;
      const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
      setCount(Math.floor(easeOut(progress) * target));
      if (progress < 1) {
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        setCount(target);
      }
    };

    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
  }, [active, target, duration]);

  return count;
}
