"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

interface UseInViewOptions {
  threshold?: number;
  rootMargin?: string;
  once?: boolean;
}

interface UseInViewReturn<T extends Element> {
  ref: React.RefObject<T>;
  inView: boolean;
}

/**
 * Custom hook that uses IntersectionObserver to detect when an element
 * enters the viewport. Includes SSR guard.
 */
export function useInView<T extends Element = HTMLDivElement>(
  options: UseInViewOptions = {}
): UseInViewReturn<T> {
  const { threshold = 0.1, rootMargin = "0px", once = false } = options;
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") {
      // SSR or unsupported environment â€” default to visible
      setInView(true);
      return;
    }

    const element = ref.current;
    if (!element) return;

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          if (once) observer.disconnect();
        } else if (!once) {
          setInView(false);
        }
      },
      { threshold, rootMargin }
    );

    observer.observe(element);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [threshold, rootMargin, once]);

  return { ref, inView };
}

"use client";

import { useScroll, useTransform, type MotionValue } from "framer-motion";

/**
 * Returns a horizontal MotionValue driven by page scroll.
 * Positive factor moves right, negative moves left.
 * Uses transform only â€” no layout reflow.
 */
export function useParallax(factor: number): MotionValue<number> {
  const { scrollY } = useScroll();
  // Map scroll 0â€“2000px to a horizontal offset
  const x = useTransform(scrollY, [0, 2000], [0, factor * 300]);
  return x;
}

/**
 * Locale and country persistence helpers.
 *
 * Storage:
 *   localStorage["bardo_locale"]  â€” chosen locale ("en" | "fr" | "ar")
 *   localStorage["bardo_country"] â€” chosen country code ("DE", "FR", etc.)
 *   cookie "NEXT_LOCALE"          â€” read by next-intl middleware for server-side routing
 *
 * The picker is shown when neither key exists in localStorage.
 * To reset (simulate first visit): clear both localStorage keys.
 */

import { locales, defaultLocale, type Locale } from "@/i18n/config";

const LOCALE_KEY = "bardo_locale";
const COUNTRY_KEY = "bardo_country";
const COOKIE_NAME = "NEXT_LOCALE";

export function getSavedLocale(): Locale | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  const v = localStorage.getItem(LOCALE_KEY);
  if (v && locales.includes(v as Locale)) return v as Locale;
  return null;
}

export function getSavedCountry(): string | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  return localStorage.getItem(COUNTRY_KEY);
}

export function hasCompletedOnboarding(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return false;
  return !!localStorage.getItem(LOCALE_KEY);
}

export function saveLocaleAndCountry(locale: Locale, country?: string): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  localStorage.setItem(LOCALE_KEY, locale);
  if (country) localStorage.setItem(COUNTRY_KEY, country);
  // Set cookie so middleware uses the chosen locale on next request
  document.cookie = `${COOKIE_NAME}=${locale}; path=/; max-age=${60 * 60 * 24 * 365}; SameSite=Lax`;
}

export function clearOnboarding(): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  localStorage.removeItem(LOCALE_KEY);
  localStorage.removeItem(COUNTRY_KEY);
  document.cookie = `${COOKIE_NAME}=; path=/; max-age=0`;
}

export function getDefaultLocaleForCountry(countryCode: string): Locale {
  // French-speaking countries default to French
  const frenchCountries = ["FR", "BE", "CH", "LU", "MC", "SN", "CI", "ML", "BF", "NE", "TG", "BJ", "GN", "CD", "CG", "CM", "GA", "MG", "MU", "DZ", "MA", "TN"];
  // Arabic-speaking countries default to Arabic
  const arabicCountries = ["TN", "DZ", "MA", "EG", "SA", "AE", "JO", "LB", "SY", "IQ", "KW", "QA", "BH", "OM", "YE", "LY", "SD", "MR", "SO", "DJ", "KM"];

  if (arabicCountries.includes(countryCode)) return "ar";
  if (frenchCountries.includes(countryCode)) return "fr";
  return defaultLocale;
}

  id: string;

     * null if no EUR fee is available â€” never invented or converted.

import type { ProjectCategory } from "@/data/projects";
import type { GroupedProject, ProjectSlot } from "./grouped-types";
import type { GisOpportunity } from "./gis-types";

/**
 * Transforms raw GIS opportunities into GroupedProject objects.
 * One GIS opportunity = one GroupedProject (slots are nested, not separate rows).
 */

function slugify(value: string) {
  return value
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/&/g, "and")
    .replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g, "")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/(^-|-$)+/g, "");
}

function stripBracketSuffix(value: string) {
  return value.replace(/\s*\[[^\]]*\]\s*/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

export function hasSlots(opp: GisOpportunity): boolean {
  return Array.isArray(opp.all_slots?.nodes) && opp.all_slots!.nodes.length > 0;
}

function mapCategory(opp: GisOpportunity): ProjectCategory {
  const id = opp.programme?.id;

  if (id === "7") return "volunteer"; // GV
  if (id === "8") return "talent";    // GTa
  if (id === "9") return "teaching";  // GTe

  return "volunteer";
}

function getProgrammeDisplay(
  programme: { id: string; short_name: string | null } | null | undefined
) {
  const p = programme as
    | ({ id: string; short_name: string | null; short_name_display?: string | null })
    | null
    | undefined;

  return p?.short_name_display ?? p?.short_name ?? "";
}

function buildDescription(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  const base = (opp.description ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  const logistics = [];
  if (opp.logistics_info?.accommodation_covered === "covered") logistics.push("accommodation");
  if (opp.logistics_info?.food_covered === "covered") logistics.push("meals");
  if (opp.logistics_info?.transportation_covered === "covered") logistics.push("transportation");

  const extras = [];
  if (logistics.length > 0) extras.push(`Includes: ${logistics.join(", ")}.`);

  const fee = getProjectFee(opp);
  if (fee.amount != null && fee.currency) {
    extras.push(`Project fee: ${fee.amount} ${fee.currency}.`);
  }

  return [base, ...extras].filter(Boolean).join(" ").trim();
}

function toProjectSlot(opp: GisOpportunity): ProjectSlot[] {
  const nodes = opp.all_slots?.nodes ?? [];
  return nodes.map((slot) => ({
    startDate: slot.start_date ?? null,
    endDate: slot.end_date ?? null,
    openings: slot.openings ?? null,
    available: slot.openings ?? null,
  }));
}

function sortDateAsc(a: string | null, b: string | null) {
  if (!a && !b) return 0;
  if (!a) return 1;
  if (!b) return -1;
  return a.localeCompare(b);
}

function sortDateDesc(a: string | null, b: string | null) {
  return sortDateAsc(b, a);
}

function getEarliestStart(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  const slotDates = (opp.all_slots?.nodes ?? [])
    .map((slot) => slot.start_date ?? null)
    .filter((v): v is string => Boolean(v))
    .sort(sortDateAsc);

  return slotDates[0] ?? opp.earliest_start_date ?? "";
}

function getLatestEnd(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  const slotDates = (opp.all_slots?.nodes ?? [])
    .map((slot) => slot.end_date ?? null)
    .filter((v): v is string => Boolean(v))
    .sort(sortDateDesc);

  return slotDates[0] ?? opp.latest_end_date ?? "";
}

function getTotalOpenings(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  const nodes = opp.all_slots?.nodes ?? [];
  if (nodes.length === 0) return opp.openings ?? null;

  const sum = nodes.reduce((acc, slot) => acc + (slot.openings ?? 0), 0);
  return sum > 0 ? sum : opp.openings ?? null;
}

function getTotalAvailable(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  if (opp.available_openings != null) return opp.available_openings;

  const nodes = opp.all_slots?.nodes ?? [];
  if (nodes.length === 0) return null;

  const sum = nodes.reduce((acc, slot) => acc + (slot.openings ?? 0), 0);
  return sum > 0 ? sum : null;
}

function getAvailableSlots(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  const nodes = opp.all_slots?.nodes ?? [];
  return nodes.reduce((acc, slot) => acc + ((slot.openings ?? 0) > 0 ? 1 : 0), 0);
}

function getProjectFee(opp: GisOpportunity): GroupedProject["fee"] {
  const fee = opp.fee_and_health_insurance;
  if (!fee || fee.currency !== "EUR") {
    return { amount: null, currency: null };
  }

  if (fee.project_fee != null) {
    return { amount: fee.project_fee, currency: "EUR" };
  }

  if (fee.programme_fee != null) {
    return { amount: fee.programme_fee, currency: "EUR" };
  }

  return { amount: null, currency: null };
}

function getLogistics(opp: GisOpportunity): GroupedProject["logistics"] {
  return {
    accommodation: opp.logistics_info?.accommodation_covered === "covered",
    food: opp.logistics_info?.food_covered === "covered",
    transport: opp.logistics_info?.transportation_covered === "covered",
  };
}

function getExternalApplyUrl(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  return opp.programme?.id === "7"
    ? `https://aiesec.org/opportunity/global-volunteer/${opp.id}`
    : null;
}

export function transformToGroupedProject(
  opp: GisOpportunity,
  fallbackSlug?: string
): GroupedProject {
  const title = stripBracketSuffix(opp.title ?? "Untitled opportunity");
  const programme = getProgrammeDisplay(opp.programme);
  const sdg = opp.sdg_info?.sdg_target?.goal_index;
  const sdgs = typeof sdg === "number" ? [sdg] : [];
  const cleanSlugBase = fallbackSlug || slugify(`${opp.id}-${title || "opportunity"}`);

  return {
    id: `opp-${opp.id}`,
    oppId: String(opp.id),
    slug: cleanSlugBase,
    title,
    description: buildDescription(opp),
    image: opp.cover_photo?.url ?? "/hero/hero_static_default.png",
    alt: opp.cover_photo?.filename ?? "",
    sdgs,
    startDate: getEarliestStart(opp),
    endDate: getLatestEnd(opp),
    city: opp.host_lc?.name ?? "",
    category: mapCategory(opp),
    isOpen: opp.status === "open" && (opp.available_openings ?? 0) > 0,
    programme,
    totalOpenings: getTotalOpenings(opp),
    totalAvailable: getTotalAvailable(opp),
    availableSlots: getAvailableSlots(opp),
    slots: toProjectSlot(opp),
    fee: getProjectFee(opp),
    logistics: getLogistics(opp),
    externalApplyUrl: getExternalApplyUrl(opp),
  };
}

export function transformAllToGroupedProjects(opps: GisOpportunity[]): GroupedProject[] {
  return opps
    .filter(hasSlots)
    .map((opp) => transformToGroupedProject(opp, slugify(`${opp.id}-${stripBracketSuffix(opp.title ?? "opportunity")}`)));
}

/**
 * Project data loader - AIESEC GIS GraphQL API.
 * Fetches open opportunities for AIESEC in Bardo (committee 1270),
 * programmes GV/GT/GE (7, 8, 9).
 * Falls back to static data/projects.ts if AIESEC_GIS_TOKEN is not set.
 */

import { projects as staticProjects } from "@/data/projects";
import type { Project } from "@/data/projects";
import type { GisOpportunity, GisOpportunitiesResponse } from "./gis-types";
import { transformGisOpportunity } from "./transform";
import { transformAllToGroupedProjects } from "./group-transform";
import type { GroupedProject } from "./grouped-types";

const GIS_ENDPOINT = "https://gis-api.aiesec.org/graphql";

const OPPORTUNITIES_QUERY = `
  query GetBardoOpportunities($page: Int, $perPage: Int) {
    allOpportunity(
      filters: {
        status: "open"
        committee: 1270
        programmes: [7, 8, 9]
      }
      pagination: { page: $page, per_page: $perPage }
    ) {
      paging { total_items total_pages current_page }
      data {
        id title description status openings available_openings
        earliest_start_date latest_end_date experience_type
        programme { id short_name_display }
        host_lc { id name full_name }
        sdg_info { sdg_target { goal_index } }
        logistics_info { accommodation_covered food_covered transportation_covered }
        fee_and_health_insurance
        cover_photo
        all_slots { nodes { start_date end_date status openings } }
      }
    }
  }
`;

async function fetchPage(
  token: string,
  page: number,
  perPage: number,
  revalidate: number
): Promise<GisOpportunitiesResponse> {
  const res = await fetch(`${GIS_ENDPOINT}?access_token=${token}`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ query: OPPORTUNITIES_QUERY, variables: { page, perPage } }),
    next: { revalidate },
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`GIS API error: ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`);
  return res.json() as Promise<GisOpportunitiesResponse>;
}

async function fetchAllOpportunities(
  token: string,
  revalidate: number,
  perPage = 50,
  maxPages = 10
): Promise<GisOpportunity[]> {
  const all: GisOpportunity[] = [];
  let page = 1;
  while (page <= maxPages) {
    const response = await fetchPage(token, page, perPage, revalidate);
    if (response.errors?.length) {
      console.error("[loader] GIS API errors:", response.errors);
      break;
    }
    const pageData = response.data?.allOpportunity;
    if (!pageData) break;
    all.push(...pageData.data);
    if (page >= pageData.paging.total_pages) break;
    page++;
  }
  return all;
}

/** Legacy flat loader - kept for backward compat (admin page, static fallback). */
export async function loadProjects(revalidate = 300): Promise<Project[]> {
  const token = process.env.AIESEC_GIS_TOKEN;
  if (!token) {
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
      console.info("[loader] AIESEC_GIS_TOKEN not set - using static fallback");
    }
    return staticProjects;
  }
  try {
    const opps = await fetchAllOpportunities(token, revalidate);
    if (opps.length === 0) {
      console.warn("[loader] GIS API returned 0 opportunities - using static fallback");
      return staticProjects;
    }
    return opps.map(transformGisOpportunity);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[loader] Failed to load GIS data:", err);
    return staticProjects;
  }
}

/** Grouped loader - one GroupedProject per OPP ID. Used by the public UI. */
export async function loadGroupedProjects(revalidate = 300): Promise<GroupedProject[]> {
  const token = process.env.AIESEC_GIS_TOKEN;
  if (!token) {
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
      console.info("[loader] AIESEC_GIS_TOKEN not set - no grouped projects available");
    }
    return [];
  }
  try {
    const opps = await fetchAllOpportunities(token, revalidate);
    if (opps.length === 0) {
      console.warn("[loader] GIS API returned 0 opportunities");
      return [];
    }
    return transformAllToGroupedProjects(opps);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[loader] Failed to load GIS data:", err);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function loadRawOpportunities(): Promise<GisOpportunity[]> {
  const token = process.env.AIESEC_GIS_TOKEN;
  if (!token) return [];
  try {
    return await fetchAllOpportunities(token, 0);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[loader] Failed to load raw GIS data:", err);
    return [];
  }
}

  if (id === "8") return "talent";    // GTa

function pickPrimarySlot(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  const slots = opp.all_slots?.nodes ?? [];
  return slots.find((slot) => slot.status === "live") ?? slots[0] ?? null;
}

function buildDescription(opp: GisOpportunity) {
  const base = (opp.description ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  const logistics = [];
  if (opp.logistics_info?.accommodation_covered === "covered") logistics.push("accommodation");
  if (opp.logistics_info?.food_covered === "covered") logistics.push("meals");
  if (opp.logistics_info?.transportation_covered === "covered") logistics.push("transportation");

  const extras = [];

}

export function transformGisOpportunity(opp: GisOpportunity): Project {
  const slot = pickPrimarySlot(opp);
  const sdg = opp.sdg_info?.sdg_target?.goal_index;
  const sdgs = typeof sdg === "number" ? [sdg] : [];

  return {
    id: `opp-${opp.id}`,
    slug: `${opp.id}-${slugify(opp.title ?? "opportunity")}`,
    title: opp.title ?? "Untitled opportunity",
    description: buildDescription(opp),
    image: opp.cover_photo?.url ?? "/hero/hero_static_default.png",
    alt: "",
    sdgs,
    startDate: slot?.start_date ?? opp.earliest_start_date ?? "",
    endDate: slot?.end_date ?? opp.latest_end_date ?? "",
    city: opp.host_lc?.name ?? "",
    category: mapCategory(opp),
    isOpen: opp.status === "open" && (opp.available_openings ?? 0) > 0,
  };
}

import type { KnowledgeEntry } from "@/data/knowledge-base";

/**
 * Lightweight className merger â€” joins truthy class strings.
 * Drop-in for clsx without the extra dependency.
 */
export function cn(...classes: (string | undefined | null | false)[]): string {
  return classes.filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}

/**
 * Matches user input against knowledge base entries by keyword substring search.
 * Accepts KnowledgeEntry[] (superset of FaqEntry[]) â€” backward compatible.
 * Returns the first matching entry, or null if no match is found.
 */
export function matchFaq(
  input: string,
  entries: KnowledgeEntry[]
): KnowledgeEntry | null {
  const normalized = input.toLowerCase().trim();
  if (!normalized) return null;

  return (
    entries.find((entry) =>
      entry.keywords.some((keyword) =>
        normalized.includes(keyword.toLowerCase())
      )
    ) ?? null
  );
}

/**
 * Filters projects by a FilterState object.
 * Pure function â€” no side effects.
 */
export interface FilterState {
  category: string;   // "all" or ProjectCategory
  sdgs: number[];
  city: string;       // "all" or city name
  status: string;     // "all" | "open" | "closed"
  startDate: string;  // ISO date string or ""
  endDate: string;    // ISO date string or ""
}

export function filterProjects<T extends {
  category: string;
  sdgs: number[];
  city: string;
  isOpen: boolean;
  startDate: string;
  endDate: string;
}>(projects: T[], filters: FilterState): T[] {
  return projects.filter((p) => {
    if (filters.category !== "all" && p.category !== filters.category) return false;
    if (filters.sdgs.length > 0 && !filters.sdgs.some((s) => p.sdgs.includes(s))) return false;
    if (filters.city !== "all" && p.city !== filters.city) return false;
    if (filters.status === "open" && !p.isOpen) return false;
    if (filters.status === "closed" && p.isOpen) return false;
    if (filters.startDate && p.endDate < filters.startDate) return false;
    if (filters.endDate && p.startDate > filters.endDate) return false;
    return true;
  });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { locales, defaultLocale } from "./i18n/config";

/**
 * Unified middleware â€” Edge Runtime safe.
 *
 * Order of operations:
 *  1. Admin route guard
 *     - production  â†’ 404 for /admin/*, /api/admin/*, /login, /api/auth/*
 *     - staging/dev â†’ /admin/* and /api/admin/* pass through directly (no auth)
 *  2. Production page route allowlist
 *  3. Static / API pass-through
 *  4. Locale routing â€” redirect bare paths to /<defaultLocale>/...
 */

function isProduction(): boolean {
  return process.env.APP_ENV === "production" || process.env.APP_ENV === undefined;
}

function getLocaleFromPathname(pathname: string): string | null {
  for (const locale of locales) {
    if (pathname === `/${locale}` || pathname.startsWith(`/${locale}/`)) {
      return locale;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Production page route allowlist.
 * Only localized home, /our-projects, and /our-projects/[slug] are permitted.
 */
function isAllowedInProduction(pathname: string): boolean {
  if (pathname === "/") return true;

  for (const locale of locales) {
    if (pathname === `/${locale}` || pathname === `/${locale}/`) return true;
    if (pathname === `/${locale}/our-projects` || pathname === `/${locale}/our-projects/`) return true;
    if (pathname.startsWith(`/${locale}/our-projects/`)) {
      const rest = pathname.slice(`/${locale}/our-projects/`.length);
      if (rest.length > 0 && !rest.includes("/")) return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}

export function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const { pathname } = request.nextUrl;

  // â”€â”€ 1. Admin route guard â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  const isAdminRoute =
    pathname.startsWith("/admin") || pathname.startsWith("/api/admin");
  const isAuthRoute =
    pathname.startsWith("/login") || pathname.startsWith("/api/auth");

  if (isProduction()) {
    // Production: block all admin, login, and auth routes
    if (isAdminRoute || isAuthRoute) {
      return new NextResponse(null, { status: 404 });
    }
  }
  // Staging/dev: admin routes pass through directly â€” no auth required

  // â”€â”€ 2. Production page route allowlist â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  if (isProduction()) {
    const isInternal =
      pathname.startsWith("/_next") ||
      pathname.startsWith("/_vercel") ||
      pathname.startsWith("/api/") ||
      /\.[^/]+$/.test(pathname);

    if (!isInternal && !isAllowedInProduction(pathname)) {
      return new NextResponse(null, { status: 404 });
    }
  }

  // â”€â”€ 3. Pass through Next.js internals, API routes, static files â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  if (
    pathname.startsWith("/_next") ||
    pathname.startsWith("/_vercel") ||
    pathname.startsWith("/api/") ||
    /\.[^/]+$/.test(pathname)
  ) {
    return NextResponse.next();
  }

  // â”€â”€ 4. Locale routing â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  // /admin is not locale-prefixed â€” pass through directly
  if (pathname.startsWith("/admin")) {
    return NextResponse.next();
  }

  const locale = getLocaleFromPathname(pathname);
  if (locale) {
    const response = NextResponse.next();
    response.headers.set("x-next-intl-locale", locale);
    return response;
  }

  // No locale prefix â†’ redirect to default locale
  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
  url.pathname = `/${defaultLocale}${pathname === "/" ? "" : pathname}`;
  return NextResponse.redirect(url);
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ["/((?!_next|_vercel|.*\\..*).*)" ],
};

param()

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

function Write-Section($title) {
  Write-Host ""
  Write-Host ("=" * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkGray
  Write-Host $title -ForegroundColor Cyan
  Write-Host ("=" * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkGray
}

function Ensure-FileContains($path) {
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path)) {
    throw "Required file not found: $path"
  }
}

function Write-TextFile($path, $content) {
  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $path
  if ($dir -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null
  }
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $content, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
  Write-Host "[written] $path" -ForegroundColor Green
}

# AIESEC Tunisia / Bardo â€” Landing Page

A production-grade, immersive landing page for the AIESEC Tunisia / Bardo experience platform.

## Tech Stack

- **Next.js 14+** (App Router)
- **TypeScript**
- **Tailwind CSS**
- **Framer Motion**
- **lucide-react**

## Getting Started

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your browser.

## Project Structure

```
/app              â€” Next.js App Router pages and layout
/components
  /layout         â€” Navbar, Footer
  /sections       â€” Page sections (Hero, Stats, Map, Food, Places, Estimator, CTA)
  /ui             â€” Shared UI primitives (MediaCard, FoodCard, PlaceCard, StatCounter, Slider)
  /chat           â€” ChatAgent, ChatPanel
  /map            â€” TunisiaMap SVG component
/data             â€” Typed content data files
/lib
  /hooks          â€” Custom React hooks (useInView, useParallax, useCounter)
  utils.ts        â€” Utility functions (cn, matchFaq)
/public
  /images         â€” Static images
  /reels          â€” Video files
```

## Content

All page content is driven by typed data files in `/data`:

- `hero-media.ts` â€” Hero section media cards
- `stats.ts` â€” Animated statistics
- `foods.ts` â€” Tunisian food showcase
- `places.ts` â€” Places to visit
- `faq.ts` â€” Chat agent FAQ responses

## Scripts

```bash
npm run dev       # Start development server
npm run build     # Production build
npm run test      # Run tests (vitest)
npm run lint      # ESLint
```

function Write-Section($title) {
  Write-Host ""
  Write-Host ("=" * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkGray
  Write-Host $title -ForegroundColor Cyan
  Write-Host ("=" * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkGray
}

function Ensure-Directory($path) {
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $path -Force | Out-Null
  }
}

function Write-TextFile($path, $content) {
  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $path
  if ($dir) { Ensure-Directory $dir }
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $content, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
  Write-Host "[written] $path" -ForegroundColor Green
}

function StatCard({
  label,
  value,
  tone = "default",
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  tone?: "default" | "success" | "accent";
}) {
  const toneClass =
    tone === "success"
      ? "text-emerald-400"
      : tone === "accent"
      ? "text-cyan-300"
      : "text-white";

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.22)]">
      <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-slate-400">
        {label}
      </p>
      <p className={`mt-3 text-3xl font-bold ${toneClass}`}>{value}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

                            className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-4 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-400"
                          >
                            {col}
                          </th>
                        ))}
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {transformed.map((p, index) => (
                        <tr
                          key={p.id}
                          className={`border-b border-white/5 ${
                            index % 2 === 0 ? "bg-white/[0.02]" : "bg-transparent"
                          } transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-400/[0.06]`}
                        >
                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-slate-200">{p.id}</td>
                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-slate-300">{p.slug}</td>
                          <td className="min-w-[220px] px-4 py-3 font-medium text-slate-100">{p.title}</td>
                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-cyan-300">
                            {getProgrammeForTransformedId(p.id)}
                          </td>
                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3">
                            <span
                              className={
                                p.isOpen
                                  ? "inline-flex rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-300"
                                  : "inline-flex rounded-full bg-slate-700/50 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300"
                              }
                            >
                              {p.isOpen ? "open" : "closed"}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-slate-300">{p.startDate ?? "-"}</td>
                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-slate-300">{p.endDate ?? "-"}</td>
                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-slate-300">{p.city ?? "-"}</td>
                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-slate-300">{p.category ?? "-"}</td>
                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-slate-300">{p.sdgs.join(", ") || "-"}</td>
                          <td className="min-w-[320px] px-4 py-3 text-slate-300">{p.description}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </DataShell>
            </section>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-8">
          <Link
            href="/admin"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-white/5 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-200 transition-colors hover:bg-white/10"
          >
            <ArrowLeft size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
            Back to admin
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

$routeContent = @'
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { loadRawOpportunities } from "@/lib/projects/loader";
import { transformGisOpportunity } from "@/lib/projects/transform";

function csvEscape(value: unknown): string {
  const str = value == null ? "" : String(value);
  return `"${str.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
}

export async function GET() {
  if (process.env.APP_ENV === "production" || process.env.APP_ENV === undefined) {
    return new NextResponse(null, { status: 404 });
  }

  const raw = await loadRawOpportunities();
  const transformed = raw.map(transformGisOpportunity);
  const active = transformed.filter((project) => project.isOpen);

  const programmeByRawId = new Map(
    raw.map((opp) => [
      String(opp.id),
      opp.programme?.short_name_display ?? opp.programme?.short_name ?? "",
    ])
  );

  const getProgrammeForTransformedId = (id: string) =>
    programmeByRawId.get(String(id).replace(/^opp-/, "")) ?? "";

  const headers = [
    "id",
    "slug",
    "title",
    "programme",
    "isOpen",
    "startDate",
    "endDate",
    "city",
    "category",
    "sdgs",
    "description",
  ];

  const lines = [
    headers.join(","),
    ...active.map((project) =>
      [
        csvEscape(project.id),
        csvEscape(project.slug),
        csvEscape(project.title),
        csvEscape(getProgrammeForTransformedId(project.id)),
        csvEscape(project.isOpen ? "open" : "closed"),
        csvEscape(project.startDate ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.endDate ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.city ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.category ?? ""),
        csvEscape(Array.isArray(project.sdgs) ? project.sdgs.join("|") : ""),
        csvEscape(project.description ?? ""),
      ].join(",")
    ),
  ];

  return new NextResponse(lines.join("\n"), {
    status: 200,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8",
      "Cache-Control": "no-store",
      "Content-Disposition": 'attachment; filename="active-projects.csv"',
    },
  });
}

  const raw = await loadRawOpportunities();
  const transformed = raw.map(transformGisOpportunity);
  const active = transformed.filter((project) => project.isOpen);

  const programmeByRawId = new Map(
    raw.map((opp) => [String(opp.id), getProgrammeDisplay(opp.programme)])
  );

  const getProgrammeForTransformedId = (id: string) =>
    programmeByRawId.get(String(id).replace(/^opp-/, "")) ?? "";

  const headers = [
    "id",
    "slug",
    "title",
    "programme",
    "isOpen",
    "startDate",
    "endDate",
    "city",
    "category",
    "sdgs",
    "description",
  ];

  const lines = [
    headers.join(","),
    ...active.map((project) =>
      [
        csvEscape(project.id),
        csvEscape(project.slug),
        csvEscape(project.title),
        csvEscape(getProgrammeForTransformedId(project.id)),
        csvEscape(project.isOpen ? "open" : "closed"),
        csvEscape(project.startDate ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.endDate ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.city ?? ""),
        csvEscape(project.category ?? ""),
        csvEscape(Array.isArray(project.sdgs) ? project.sdgs.join("|") : ""),
        csvEscape(project.description ?? ""),
      ].join(",")
    ),
  ];

  return new NextResponse(lines.join("\n"), {
    status: 200,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8",
      "Cache-Control": "no-store",
      "Content-Disposition": 'attachment; filename="active-projects.csv"',
    },
  });
}

  Write-Host ""
  Write-Host ("=" * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkGray
  Write-Host $title -ForegroundColor Cyan
  Write-Host ("=" * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkGray

function Ensure-FileContains($path) {
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path)) {
    throw "Required file not found: $path"
  }
}

function Write-TextFile($path, $content) {
  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $path
  if ($dir -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null
  }
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $content, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
  Write-Host "[written] $path" -ForegroundColor Green
}

/**
 * Unit tests for the grouped projects pipeline.
 *
 * Tests:
 * 1. cleanTitle removes square-bracket content
 * 2. transformToGroupedProject produces correct shape
 * 3. Totals (openings, available) are taken from opp-level fields
 * 4. Slots are mapped correctly
 * 5. GV programme produces external apply URL
 * 6. Non-GV programme produces null externalApplyUrl
 * 7. Slug no longer includes OPP ID
 * 8. Duplicate titles are disambiguated with numeric suffix
 * 9. Opportunities with no slots are excluded
 * 10. Project fee uses EUR project_fee field only
 */

import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import {
  cleanTitle,
  slugify,
  transformToGroupedProject,
  transformAllToGroupedProjects,
  hasSlots,
} from "../lib/projects/group-transform";
import type { GisOpportunity } from "../lib/projects/gis-types";

// â”€â”€ Minimal GIS opportunity factory â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

function makeOpp(overrides: Partial<GisOpportunity> = {}): GisOpportunity {
  return {
    id: "12345",
    title: "Scale Up! [6 weeks]",
    description: "A great opportunity.",
    status: "open",
    openings: 10,
    available_openings: 4,
    earliest_start_date: "2026-06-01",
    latest_end_date: "2026-07-15",
    experience_type: "physical",
    programme: { id: "7", short_name: "GV" },
    host_lc: { id: "1270", name: "AIESEC in Bardo", full_name: "AIESEC in Bardo" },
    sdg_info: { sdg_target: { goal_index: 4 } },
    logistics_info: {
      accommodation_covered: "covered",
      food_covered: "covered",
      transportation_covered: "not_covered",
    },
    fee_and_health_insurance: {
      programme_fee: 200,
      project_fee: 150,
      total: 250,
      currency: "EUR",
      country: "TN",
    },
    cover_photo: null,
    all_slots: {
      nodes: [
        { start_date: "2026-06-01", end_date: "2026-06-30", status: "live", openings: 5 },
        { start_date: "2026-07-01", end_date: "2026-07-15", status: "live", openings: 5 },
      ],
    },
    ...overrides,
  };
}

// â”€â”€ cleanTitle â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

describe("cleanTitle", () => {
  it("removes square-bracket content and trims", () => {
    expect(cleanTitle("Scale Up! [6 weeks]")).toBe("Scale Up!");
    expect(cleanTitle("Global Classroom [6 weeks]")).toBe("Global Classroom");
    expect(cleanTitle("No brackets here")).toBe("No brackets here");
    expect(cleanTitle("[Prefix] Title")).toBe("Title");
    expect(cleanTitle("Title [A] and [B]")).toBe("Title and");
    expect(cleanTitle("  Spaced  [x]  ")).toBe("Spaced");
  });
});

// â”€â”€ slug â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

describe("slug generation", () => {
  it("slug does NOT include OPP ID", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(makeOpp(), "scale-up");
    expect(result.slug).toBe("scale-up");
    expect(result.slug).not.toContain("12345");
  });

  it("slug is the slugified clean title", () => {
    const slug = slugify(cleanTitle("Scale Up! [6 weeks]"));
    expect(slug).toBe("scale-up");
  });

  it("duplicate titles get numeric suffix via transformAllToGroupedProjects", () => {
    const opps = [
      makeOpp({ id: "1", title: "Scale Up! [6 weeks]" }),
      makeOpp({ id: "2", title: "Scale Up! [8 weeks]" }), // same clean title
      makeOpp({ id: "3", title: "Scale Up! [10 weeks]" }), // same clean title
    ];
    const results = transformAllToGroupedProjects(opps);
    expect(results).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(results[0].slug).toBe("scale-up");
    expect(results[1].slug).toBe("scale-up-2");
    expect(results[2].slug).toBe("scale-up-3");
  });

  it("unique titles get clean slugs without suffix", () => {
    const opps = [
      makeOpp({ id: "1", title: "Scale Up! [6 weeks]" }),
      makeOpp({ id: "2", title: "Global Classroom [4 weeks]" }),
    ];
    const results = transformAllToGroupedProjects(opps);
    expect(results[0].slug).toBe("scale-up");
    expect(results[1].slug).toBe("global-classroom");
  });
});

// â”€â”€ slot filtering â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

describe("slot filtering", () => {
  it("hasSlots returns true when slots exist", () => {
    expect(hasSlots(makeOpp())).toBe(true);
  });

  it("hasSlots returns false when all_slots is null", () => {
    expect(hasSlots(makeOpp({ all_slots: null }))).toBe(false);
  });

  it("hasSlots returns false when nodes array is empty", () => {
    expect(hasSlots(makeOpp({ all_slots: { nodes: [] } }))).toBe(false);
  });

  it("transformAllToGroupedProjects excludes opps with no slots", () => {
    const opps = [
      makeOpp({ id: "1", title: "Has Slots [4 weeks]" }),
      makeOpp({ id: "2", title: "No Slots [4 weeks]", all_slots: { nodes: [] } }),
      makeOpp({ id: "3", title: "Also No Slots", all_slots: null }),
    ];
    const results = transformAllToGroupedProjects(opps);
    expect(results).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(results[0].oppId).toBe("1");
  });
});

// â”€â”€ fee â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

describe("project fee", () => {
  it("uses project_fee when currency is EUR", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(
      makeOpp({
        fee_and_health_insurance: {
          project_fee: 150,
          programme_fee: 200,
          total: 250,
          currency: "EUR",
          country: "TN",
        },
      }),
      "scale-up"
    );
    expect(result.fee.amount).toBe(150);
    expect(result.fee.currency).toBe("EUR");
  });

  it("falls back to programme_fee when project_fee is null and currency is EUR", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(
      makeOpp({
        fee_and_health_insurance: {
          project_fee: null,
          programme_fee: 200,
          total: 250,
          currency: "EUR",
          country: "TN",
        },
      }),
      "scale-up"
    );
    expect(result.fee.amount).toBe(200);
    expect(result.fee.currency).toBe("EUR");
  });

  it("returns null when currency is not EUR", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(
      makeOpp({
        fee_and_health_insurance: {
          project_fee: 500,
          programme_fee: 400,
          total: 600,
          currency: "TND",
          country: "TN",
        },
      }),
      "scale-up"
    );
    expect(result.fee.amount).toBeNull();
    expect(result.fee.currency).toBeNull();
  });

  it("returns null when fee is null", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(
      makeOpp({ fee_and_health_insurance: null }),
      "scale-up"
    );
    expect(result.fee.amount).toBeNull();
    expect(result.fee.currency).toBeNull();
  });
});

// â”€â”€ transformToGroupedProject â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

describe("transformToGroupedProject", () => {
  it("produces one grouped project per opp", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(makeOpp(), "scale-up");
    expect(result.id).toBe("opp-12345");
    expect(result.oppId).toBe("12345");
  });

  it("cleans the title", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(makeOpp({ title: "Scale Up! [6 weeks]" }), "scale-up");
    expect(result.title).toBe("Scale Up!");
  });

  it("maps opp-level totals correctly", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(makeOpp({ openings: 10, available_openings: 4 }), "scale-up");
    expect(result.totalOpenings).toBe(10);
    expect(result.totalAvailable).toBe(4);
  });

  it("availableSlots sums slot openings", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(makeOpp(), "scale-up");
    // makeOpp has slots with openings 5 + 5 = 10
    expect(result.availableSlots).toBe(10);
  });

  it("availableSlots handles null slot openings", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(
      makeOpp({
        all_slots: {
          nodes: [
            { start_date: "2026-06-01", end_date: "2026-06-30", status: "live", openings: null },
            { start_date: "2026-07-01", end_date: "2026-07-15", status: "live", openings: 2 },
          ],
        },
      }),
      "scale-up"
    );
    expect(result.availableSlots).toBe(2);
  });

  it("availableSlots is 0 when no slots", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(makeOpp({ all_slots: null }), "scale-up");
    expect(result.availableSlots).toBe(0);
  });

  it("maps slots correctly", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(makeOpp(), "scale-up");
    expect(result.slots).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(result.slots[0].startDate).toBe("2026-06-01");
    expect(result.slots[0].endDate).toBe("2026-06-30");
    expect(result.slots[0].openings).toBe(5);
    expect(result.slots[1].startDate).toBe("2026-07-01");
  });

  it("handles missing slots gracefully", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(makeOpp({ all_slots: null }), "scale-up");
    expect(result.slots).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(result.startDate).toBe("2026-06-01");
    expect(result.endDate).toBe("2026-07-15");
  });

  it("GV programme produces external apply URL", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(makeOpp({ programme: { id: "7", short_name: "GV" } }), "scale-up");
    expect(result.externalApplyUrl).toBe("https://aiesec.org/opportunity/global-volunteer/12345");
  });

  it("GT programme produces null externalApplyUrl", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(makeOpp({ programme: { id: "8", short_name: "GT" } }), "scale-up");
    expect(result.externalApplyUrl).toBeNull();
  });

  it("GE programme produces null externalApplyUrl", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(makeOpp({ programme: { id: "9", short_name: "GE" } }), "scale-up");
    expect(result.externalApplyUrl).toBeNull();
  });

  it("maps logistics correctly", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(makeOpp(), "scale-up");
    expect(result.logistics.accommodation).toBe(true);
    expect(result.logistics.food).toBe(true);
    expect(result.logistics.transport).toBe(false);
  });

  it("maps SDG correctly", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(makeOpp(), "scale-up");
    expect(result.sdgs).toContain(4);
  });

  it("isOpen is true when status=open and available_openings > 0", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(makeOpp({ status: "open", available_openings: 4 }), "scale-up");
    expect(result.isOpen).toBe(true);
  });

  it("isOpen is false when available_openings is 0", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(makeOpp({ status: "open", available_openings: 0 }), "scale-up");
    expect(result.isOpen).toBe(false);
  });

  it("derives city from host_lc name", () => {
    const result = transformToGroupedProject(makeOpp(), "scale-up");
    expect(result.city).toBe("Bardo");
  });
});

param()

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

function Write-Section($title) {
  Write-Host ""
  Write-Host ("=" * 72) -ForegroundColor DarkGray
  Write-Host $title -ForegroundColor Cyan
  Write-Host ("=" * 72) -ForegroundColor DarkGray
}

function Find-File($root) {
  $paths = @(
    "lib\projects\loader.ts",
    "lib\projects\fetch.ts",
    "lib\projects\api.ts"
  )

  foreach ($p in $paths) {
    $full = Join-Path $root $p
    if (Test-Path $full) { return $full }
  }

  throw "Could not find GraphQL loader file"
}

function Replace-Content($file) {
  $content = Get-Content $file -Raw

  # safer replace only inside programme block
  $content = $content -replace 'programme\s*\{[^}]*short_name[^}]*\}', 'programme { id short_name_display }'

  Set-Content -Path $file -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
  Write-Host "[patched] $file" -ForegroundColor Green
}

Write-Section "Resolving project root"
$root = (Get-Location).Path
Write-Host $root -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Section "Locating GraphQL query file"
$file = Find-File $root
Write-Host $file -ForegroundColor Yellow

Write-Section "Applying query change"
Replace-Content $file

Write-Section "Done"
Write-Host "Query now uses short_name_display (GV / GTa / GTe)" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Run:"
Write-Host "  npm run build"
